entries.name: Buff Effect
entries.definition: Changes the strength of the applicable buff’s effects. The modifier must specify which buff or buffs it affects.

entries.name: No Reservation
entries.definition: The specified skill reserves none of its usual resource. This does not by itself change other costs of the skill.

entries.name: Armour
entries.definition: A defence that reduces physical damage from hits. Its effectiveness depends on the size of the physical hit relative to your armour; it does not reduce physical damage over time.

entries.name: Attack Speed
entries.definition: Affects how quickly attack skills are performed. Most attacks derive their base attack time from the equipped weapon; action speed is a separate factor.

entries.name: Burning Ground
entries.definition: A damaging ground effect that deals fire damage over time. Burning ground is distinct from ignite; its damage depends on the source.

entries.name: Cast Speed
entries.definition: Affects how quickly spells are cast. Increasing cast speed reduces cast time; this does not by itself reduce a skill’s cooldown.

entries.name: Chaos Resistance
entries.definition: Resistance applied to incoming chaos damage. Elemental resistance modifiers do not grant chaos resistance; modifiers to all resistances include it.

entries.name: Cold Resistance
entries.definition: Resistance applied to incoming cold damage, including hits and damage over time. Its benefit is limited by maximum resistance.

entries.name: Critical Strike
entries.definition: A hit whose damage is multiplied by the critical strike multiplier. Damage over time does not hit and cannot critically strike.

entries.name: Elemental Resistance
entries.definition: A modifier to elemental resistances affects fire, cold and lightning resistance. It does not affect chaos resistance.

entries.name: Energy Shield
entries.definition: A defence that generally absorbs damage before life and can recharge after a period without taking damage. Special mechanics can bypass or change how it protects life.

entries.name: Evasion
entries.definition: A defence checked against an attacker’s accuracy to determine whether an attack hit is evaded. It does not evade spell hits.

entries.name: Fire Resistance
entries.definition: Resistance applied to incoming fire damage, including hits and damage over time. The maximum resistance limits the benefit; resistance is distinct from damage reduction.

entries.name: Life
entries.definition: The health resource of a character or monster. Reaching zero life normally causes death.

entries.name: Lightning Resistance
entries.definition: Resistance applied to incoming lightning damage, including hits and damage over time. Its benefit is limited by maximum resistance.

entries.name: Maximum Life
entries.definition: The upper limit of the life resource before effects such as reservation. This is distinct from your current amount of life.

entries.name: Movement Speed
entries.definition: Determines how fast an entity moves by running. Action speed is a separate modifier that also affects movement animations.

entries.name: Physical Damage
entries.definition: One of the five damage types. Armour mitigates physical damage from hits; it does not mitigate physical damage over time such as bleeding.

entries.name: Recently
entries.definition: Refers to the past four seconds.

entries.name: Reservation
entries.definition: Sets aside part of a resource, usually mana or life, while an ongoing skill is active. The reserved portion is unavailable for other uses; reservation does not lower the resource’s maximum.

entries.name: Stun
entries.definition: An interruption caused by a hit that briefly stops an entity from acting. Stun chance depends on the hit damage relative to the target’s stun threshold.

entries.name: Stun Threshold
entries.definition: The effective life value against which hit damage is compared when determining stun chance. Reducing an enemy’s stun threshold makes a given hit more likely to stun.

entries.name: Unaffected
entries.definition: The specified effect can still be present on you, but has no effect on you. This differs from immunity, which prevents or removes the specified effect.

entries.name: Absolution
entries.definition: Damages enemies in an area, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the corpse will be consumed to summon a Sentinel of Absolution for a secondary duration, or to refresh the duration and life of an existing one instead if you have the maximum number of them. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Absolution of Inspiring
entries.definition: Damages enemies in an area, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the corpse will be consumed to summon a Sentinel of Absolution for a secondary duration, or to refresh the duration and life of an existing one instead if you have the maximum number of them. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Alchemist's Mark
entries.definition: Curses a single enemy, granting flask charges when you hit them and creating Burning Ground under them if your hit Ignites them, and Caustic Ground if it Poisons them. Damage modifiers do not apply to these ground effects. You can only have one Mark at a time. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ambush
entries.definition: Teleports you to a nearby enemy, applying a buff to you for a short duration and blinding the enemy for a secondary duration. Performing a melee attack with a One-Handed Weapon removes the buff to exert that attack. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ancestral Cry
entries.definition: Performs a warcry, taunting all nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent strike attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that  grants elemental resistances. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Anger
entries.definition: Casts an aura that adds fire damage to the attacks and spells of you and your allies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Animate Guardian
entries.definition: Animates a melee weapon or armour, attaching it to an invisible Guardian that fights by your side. Animating multiple items attaches them to the same Guardian. You cannot animate unidentified items. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines. If your Guardian dies you cannot summon an Animated Guardian again in that area. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Animate Guardian of Smiting
entries.definition: Animates a melee weapon or armour, attaching it to an invisible Guardian that fights by your side using Smite of Divine Judgement, ignoring weapon restrictions. Animating multiple items attaches them to the same Guardian. You cannot animate unidentified items. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines. If your Guardian dies you cannot summon an Animated Guardian again in that area. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Animate Weapon
entries.definition: Animates a Melee Weapon Item or Lingering Blade to fight by your side. You cannot animate unidentified Weapons. Will not animate weapons with 6 sockets. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Animate Weapon of Self Reflection
entries.definition: Animates a copy of your main hand Melee Weapon to fight by your side. Cannot be used by Totems, Traps or Mines. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Animate Weapon of Ranged Arms
entries.definition: Animates a Ranged Weapon Item or Lingering Blade to fight by your side. You cannot animate unidentified Weapons. Will not animate weapons with 6 sockets. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Arc
entries.definition: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies, but not immediately back. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy that the main arc has not already hit, which cannot chain further. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Arc of Surging
entries.definition: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and splits to simultaneously hit several other enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Arc of Oscillating
entries.definition: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy, but this secondary arc cannot chain further. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Arcane Cloak
entries.definition: Spends a portion of your mana to grant a buff that takes some of the damage from hits for you until depleted. The buff grants added lightning damage based on the amount of mana spent by this skill. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Arctic Armour
entries.definition: Conjures an icy barrier that chills enemies when they hit you. You drop chilled ground while moving, and take less Fire and Physical damage while stationary. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Armageddon Brand
entries.definition: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky. The brand will detach if the enemy dies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Armageddon Brand of Volatility
entries.definition: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It activates once, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky, then is destroyed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Armageddon Brand of Recall
entries.definition: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky. The brand will detach if the enemy dies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Artillery Ballista
entries.definition: Summons a ballista totem that propels a sequence of fiery arrows into the air. The arrows impact the ground in a line, each dealing area damage to enemies around it. Requires a Bow. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Artillery Ballista of Cross Strafe
entries.definition: Summons a ballista totem that propels a sequence of fiery arrows into the air. The arrows impact the ground in two perpendicular lines, each dealing area damage to enemies around it. Requires a Bow. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Artillery Ballista of Focus Fire
entries.definition: Summons a ballista totem that propels a number of fiery arrows into the air, each targeting a specific enemy. Arrows deal area damage to enemies around it on landing. Requires a Bow. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Assassin's Mark
entries.definition: Curses a single enemy, making them more vulnerable to Critical Strikes. Killing the cursed enemy will grant life and mana, and a power charge. You can only have one Mark at a time. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Autoexertion
entries.definition: Reserves mana based on the supported warcries to cause those warcries to be repeatedly triggered. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Automation
entries.definition: While this skill is active, supported spells will be repeatedly triggered. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ball Lightning
entries.definition: Fires a slow-moving projectile that damages each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ball Lightning of Orbiting
entries.definition: Fires a single projectile which moves in a spiral while damaging each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ball Lightning of Static
entries.definition: Creates a ball of lightning at a location that damages each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning. Cannot be supported by Spell Echo or used by Totems. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Bane
entries.definition: Applies a debuff to enemies in an area, which deals chaos damage over Time. Linked hex curses are also applied to those enemies. The debuff deals more damage and lasts longer for each hex applied this way.  This skill cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Bane of Condemnation
entries.definition: Applies a debuff to enemies in a small area, which deals chaos damage over Time. Linked hex curses are also applied to those enemies. The debuff deals more damage and lasts longer for each hex applied this way.  This skill cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Barrage
entries.definition: After a short preparation time, you fire individual projectiles repeatedly with a Bow or Wand. These projectiles have a small randomised spread. This skill cannot be Triggered. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Barrage of Volley Fire
entries.definition: After a short preparation time, you fire projectiles repeatedly with a Bow or Wand. These projectiles have a small randomised spread. This skill cannot be Triggered. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Battlemage's Cry
entries.definition: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that boosts critical strike chance. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Bear Trap
entries.definition: Throws a trap that damages and immobilises a single enemy for a duration based on how much damage was dealt. After the immobilise expires, a debuff remains on the enemy for a duration, lowering their movement speed by an amount which lessens over time. The affected enemy will take increased damage from traps and mines until the debuff expires. Modifiers to spell damage do not affect this skill's damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Bear Trap of Skewers
entries.definition: Throws a trap that damages and impales a single enemy, and immobilises them for a duration based on how much damage was dealt. Modifiers to spell damage do not affect this skill's damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Berserk
entries.definition: Consumes Rage at an accelerating rate to increase the effects of Rage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Blade Blast
entries.definition: Deals spell damage in a targeted area. Each time this spell deals damage,  it will detonate any of your Lingering Blades it touches, dealing damage again in an area around them. Up to 50 Blades can be detonated this way. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Blade Blast of Unloading
entries.definition: Deals spell damage in an area around you. If you have Blade Vortex blades orbiting you, it will detonate each of them in turn, dealing damage again in an area around you for each one. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Blade Blast of Dagger Detonation
entries.definition: Deals spell damage in an area around you. Your equipped daggers add to this damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Blade Flurry
entries.definition: Repeatedly hit enemies in a circle in front of you while channelling, dealing damage to and around the enemy. The damage is continually boosted while channelling. You unleash an additional hit for each stage reached once the channelling ends. Requires a Dagger, Claw or One-Handed Sword. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Blade Flurry of Incision
entries.definition: Repeatedly hit enemies in a circle in front of you while channelling, dealing damage to and around the enemy. The critical strike chance is continually boosted while channelling. You unleash an additional hit for each stage reached once the channelling ends. Requires a Dagger, Claw or One-Handed Sword. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Blade Trap
entries.definition: Throws a trap which, once triggered, swings two copies of your equipped Dagger, Claw or One Handed Sword around it in circles, each repeatedly damaging enemies it spins through. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Blade Trap of Greatswords
entries.definition: Throws a trap which, once triggered, swings two copies of your equipped Two Handed Sword around it in circles for a duration, each repeatedly damaging enemies it spins through This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Blade Trap of Laceration
entries.definition: Throws a trap which, once triggered, swings two copies of your equipped Dagger, Claw, One Handed Sword or One Handed Axe around it in a circle, each damaging enemies it spins through. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Blade Vortex
entries.definition: This spell creates ethereal blades which orbit in an area around you, dealing damage every 0.6 seconds to all enemies in their radius. As more blades are added, the damage becomes greater and more frequent. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Blade Vortex of the Scythe
entries.definition: This spell creates a swarm of ethereal blades which briefly orbit in an area around you, dealing damage every 0.6 seconds to all enemies in their radius. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Bladefall
entries.definition: Ethereal weapons rain from the sky, dealing damage to enemies in a sequence of volleys. Enemies can be hit multiple times where these overlap. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Bladefall of Volleys
entries.definition: Ethereal weapons rain from the sky, dealing damage to enemies in a sequence of volleys, each wider and more damaging than the last. Enemies can be hit multiple times where these overlap. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Bladefall of Impaling
entries.definition: Ethereal weapons rain from the sky, dealing damage to enemies in a sequence of volleys. Enemies can be hit multiple times where these overlap. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Bladefall of Trarthus
entries.definition: Once activated, continuously spends mana to cause volleys of ethereal weapons rain from the sky around you, dealing damage to enemies they impact. Each Blade will target a separate enemy in the volley area if possible. Each enemy can only be hit once by each volley, even if multiple blades land near them. This skill cannot be triggered or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Bladestorm
entries.definition: Perform a spinning attack, damaging enemies around you and creating a bladestorm matching your stance. The bladestorm repeatedly damages enemies, based on your weapon damage and attack time, for a duration. Blood bladestorms are stationary and cause Bleeding, while Sand bladestorms move slowly forwards and Blind enemies. Requires a Sword or Axe. You are in Blood Stance by default. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Bladestorm of Uncertainty
entries.definition: Perform a spinning attack, damaging enemies around you and creating a random bladestorm. The bladestorm repeatedly damages enemies, based on your weapon damage and attack time, for a duration. Blood bladestorms are stationary and cause Bleeding, while Sand bladestorms move slowly forwards and Blind enemies. Requires a Sword or Axe. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Blast Rain
entries.definition: Fires arrows up in the air, to rain down in an area. Each arrow deals area damage around where it lands, and they will all overlap on the targeted location. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Blast Rain of Trarthus
entries.definition: Fires a single arrow up in the air, to rain down at a targeted location. The arrow deals area damage around where it lands, as well as releasing a wave of fire which will apply a burning debuff to enemies. The impact of the arrow will also inflict this debuff. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Blazing Salvo
entries.definition: Fires projectiles which fly in an arc, dealing area damage on impact with either enemies or the ground near where you target. Targeting farther away causes the projectiles to spread out and land over a wider area. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Blight
entries.definition: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a shorter secondary duration, slowing their movement. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Blight of Contagion
entries.definition: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a shorter secondary duration, slowing their movement. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration. The damaging debuff is spread by Contagion. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Blight of Atrophy
entries.definition: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a longer secondary duration, slowing their movement and reducing their life regeneration rate. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Blink Arrow
entries.definition: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Blink Arrow of Bombarding Clones
entries.definition: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire arrows into the air to land around a target. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Blink Arrow of Prismatic Clones
entries.definition: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire random elemental arrows which convert all physical damage to the chosen element and deal no damage of other damage types. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Blood and Sand
entries.definition: Casts a buff that grants different bonuses to melee skills depending on your stance. Using the skill again alternates between Blood Stance and Sand Stance. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Blood Rage
entries.definition: Adds a buff that deals Physical Damage over time, while increasing Attack Speed and Life Leech. Killing an enemy while this buff is active refreshes the buff duration, and can grant a Frenzy Charge. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Bodyswap
entries.definition: Violently destroys your body and recreates it at the location of a targeted enemy or corpse, dealing spell damage in an area at both locations. If there is no specific target, it will prioritise corpses over enemies. If targeting a corpse, the corpse will also explode, dealing damage around it that is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected. This spell cannot be repeated. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Bodyswap of Sacrifice
entries.definition: Violently destroys your body and recreates it at the location of a targeted enemy or damageable minion, dealing spell damage in an area at both locations. If there is no specific target, it will prioritise minions over enemies. If targeting a minion, the minion will also be destroyed in an explosion which deals damage around it that is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected. This spell cannot be repeated. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Bone Offering
entries.definition: Consumes a corpse, granting all of your minions the power to block both attacks and spells. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Boneshatter
entries.definition: Attack enemies with a forceful melee strike that also hurts you. Successive uses will raise the damage dealt both to enemies and you. Stunning an enemy with the strike releases a damaging pulse. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe or Staff. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Boneshatter of Complex Trauma
entries.definition: Attack enemies with a forceful melee strike that also hurts you. Successive uses will raise the damage dealt both to enemies and you. Stunning an enemy with the strike releases a damaging pulse. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe or Staff. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Boneshatter of Carnage
entries.definition: Attack enemies with a forceful melee strike. Stunning an enemy with the strike releases a damaging pulse. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe or Staff. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Brand Recall
entries.definition: Recall your brands to you, detaching them from enemies and increasing attachment range until they next attach to an enemy. Spends a portion of each recalled brand's cost to cause it to activate. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Arcanist Brand
entries.definition: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, triggering linked spells. The brand will detach if the enemy dies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Burning Arrow
entries.definition: Fires a burning arrow that deals fire damage and has a chance to ignite. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Burning Arrow of Vigour
entries.definition: Fires a burning arrow that deals fire damage and has a chance to ignite. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Caustic Arrow
entries.definition: Fires an arrow which deals chaos damage in an area on impact, and spreads caustic ground. Enemies standing on the caustic ground take chaos damage over time. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Caustic Arrow of Poison
entries.definition: Fires a poisonous arrow which deals chaos damage in an area on impact. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Chain Hook
entries.definition: When used at range, throws out a chain, pulling you to the enemy hit dealing damage in an area behind them. When close to the enemy, just causes the area damage directly. Requires a One Handed Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Axe. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Chain Hook of Angling
entries.definition: Cast your fishing rod towards a number of enemies in front of you. Non-unique enemies far away from you are pulled towards you. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Chain Hook of Trarthus
entries.definition: Throws chains ahead of you, attaching them to targets hit. Enemies chained to you will grant rage when hit. When chains are broken, they snap and deal attack damage in an area around the target they were attached to. Requires a One Handed Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Axe. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Charged Dash
entries.definition: Channel to project an illusion which you steer. You gain stages while it moves, until it stops at a maximum total distance. Waves of area damage frequently pulse along its path, based on your attack speed. Stop channelling to teleport to the illusion, dealing a final wave of damage. Requires a Melee Weapon. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Charged Dash of Projection
entries.definition: Channel to project an illusion which you steer. You gain stages while it moves, until it stops at a maximum total distance. Waves of area damage frequently pulse along its path, based on your attack speed. Stop channelling to release the illusion, dealing a final wave of damage. Requires a Melee Weapon. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Clarity
entries.definition: Casts an aura that grants mana regeneration to you and your allies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Cleave
entries.definition: The character swings their weapon (or both weapons if dual wielding) in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Only works with Axes and Swords. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Cleave of Rage
entries.definition: The character swings both their weapons in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Requires dual wielding both an Axe and a Sword. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Cobra Lash
entries.definition: Fires a poisonous projectile based on your weapon that will chain between enemies. Requires a Dagger or Claw. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Cold Snap
entries.definition: Creates a sudden burst of cold in a targeted area, damaging enemies. Also creates an expanding area which is filled with chilled ground, and deals cold damage over time to enemies. Enemies that die while in the area have a chance to grant Frenzy Charges. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Cold Snap of Power
entries.definition: Creates a sudden burst of cold in a targeted area, damaging enemies. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Power Charge. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Conductivity
entries.definition: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their lightning resistance and giving them a chance to be shocked when hit. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Conflagration
entries.definition: Fire arrows into the air that rain down around the targeted area, dealing area damage on impact and leaving the arrows stuck in the ground for a duration. If you move close to a stuck arrow, it will explode, dealing area damage and applying a fire damage over time debuff, as well as causing other stuck arrows in range to also explode. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Consecrated Path
entries.definition: Slams the ground at a targeted location. If an enemy is near where you target, you'll teleport to it from a short distance away, slam, and create an area of consecrated ground. Can't be supported by Multistrike, and requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Consecrated Path of Endurance
entries.definition: Slams the ground at a targeted location. If an enemy is near where you target, you'll teleport to it from a short distance away, slam, and create an area of consecrated ground. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge. Can't be supported by Multistrike, and requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Contagion
entries.definition: Unleashes a vile contagion on enemies, dealing chaos damage over time. If an enemy dies while affected by Contagion, the debuff spreads to other enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Contagion of Subsiding
entries.definition: Unleashes a vile contagion on enemies, dealing chaos damage over time. If an enemy dies while affected by Contagion, the debuff spreads to other enemies, but each time it spreads, it only deals three quarters as much damage as before. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Contagion of Transference
entries.definition: Unleashes a vile contagion on enemies, dealing chaos damage over time. If an enemy is hit while affected by Contagion, the debuff spreads to other enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Conversion Trap
entries.definition: Throws a trap that, when triggered by an enemy, converts that enemy to your side for a short duration. Does not affect unique monsters or players. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Convocation
entries.definition: Recalls all minions that are following you to your location, and grants them a temporary life regeneration effect. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Corrupting Fever
entries.definition: Draws out your own blood to power a buff for a duration, letting this skill inflict the Corrupting Blood debuff on enemies you hit, dealing physical damage over time for a short secondary duration. The buff's duration will be refreshed if you spend enough life before it expires. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Crackling Lance
entries.definition: Release a beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you, and has several smaller beams branch off from it at an angle, hitting more enemies to the sides. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Crackling Lance of Branching
entries.definition: Release a beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you, and has several smaller beams branch off from it at an angle, hitting more enemies to the sides. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Crackling Lance of Disintegration
entries.definition: Release a concentrated beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Creeping Frost
entries.definition: Fire an icy projectile that bursts on impact or when reaching the targeted area, dealing area damage and creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time. This area will creep across the ground towards nearby enemies until its duration expires. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Creeping Frost of Floes
entries.definition: Fire a single icy projectile that bursts on impact or when reaching the targeted area, dealing area damage and creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time. This area will creep rapidly across the ground towards nearby enemies until its duration expires. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Cremation
entries.definition: A targeted corpse explodes, dealing area damage and turning into a volcanic geyser, which will repeatedly unleash projectiles sequentially over the surrounding area for a duration. The explosion of the corpse is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Cremation of Exhuming
entries.definition: A targeted corpse explodes, dealing area damage and turning into a volcanic geyser, which will repeatedly unleash projectiles sequentially over the surrounding area and detonate nearby corpses for a duration. Corpse explosions are not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Cremation of the Volcano
entries.definition: Creates a volcanic geyser at a location, which will repeatedly unleash projectiles sequentially over the surrounding area for a duration. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Crushing Fist
entries.definition: Retaliate against a blocked hit by calling forth a huge armoured fist to slam into the ground in front of you as you do the same, dealing weapon damage in an area. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Cyclone
entries.definition: Channel this skill to move towards a targeted location while spinning constantly attacking enemies in an area around you. While channelling this skill, you cannot be knocked back. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Cyclone of Tumult
entries.definition: Channel this skill to move towards a targeted location while spinning constantly attacking enemies in an area around you. While channelling this skill, you cannot be knocked back. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Dark Bargain
entries.definition: This spell removes some life from one of your Skeleton minions near you or the targeted location to deal chaos damage in an area around it. This effect will chain to your other nearby skeletons. If you have no skeletons near you or the targeted location, it will sacrifice your own life to deal damage instead. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Dark Bargain of Trarthus
entries.definition: This spell deals chaos damage in an area around you. Casting this spell will cause you to gain Ruin. If this spell inflicts your seventh Ruin, it will sacrifice a large portion of your life to deal extra chaos damage based on the amount sacrificed, and remove all Ruin from you. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Dash
entries.definition: Performs a series of quick teleports towards a targeted location. If using the "Attack in Place" option, the direction is reversed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Decoy Totem
entries.definition: Summons a totem that taunts nearby monsters to attack it. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Defiance Banner
entries.definition: You must gain Valour from melee combat to use this skill, which will consume all Valour to place a banner with an aura. The aura will be larger and more powerful the more Valour was consumed. The banner lasts for a duration, but will end early if you leave the aura, or use the skill again while it's active. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Desecrate
entries.definition: Desecrates the ground, spawning corpses based on monsters in the current area and dealing chaos damage over time to enemies. If you are using the Raise Spectre skill there is a chance to spawn spectral corpses matching your most recently raised Spectres. Spectral corpses cannot be interacted with except by Minion skills. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Despair
entries.definition: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their chaos resistance. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Destructive Link
entries.definition: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they use your main hand critical strike chance. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Determination
entries.definition: Casts an aura that grants armour to you and your allies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Detonate Dead
entries.definition: Targets a corpse, and deals spell damage to enemies around the corpse, as well as causing the corpse to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Detonate Dead of Scavenging
entries.definition: Targets a corpse, causing it to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected. Cannot target corpses that have been created by skills. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Detonate Dead of Chain Reaction
entries.definition: Targets a corpse, and deals spell damage to enemies around the corpse, as well as causing the corpse to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected. This will continue to target other corpses in the area, with a shorter delay between each one, until it runs out of corpses or has destroyed 8 corpses. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Devouring Totem
entries.definition: Summons a totem that can consume nearby corpses. If you are hurt, it will destroy a corpse to leech life to you. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Discharge
entries.definition: Discharge all the character's charges to deal elemental damage to all nearby monsters. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Discharge of Misery
entries.definition: Discharge all the character's charges to deal elemental damage to all nearby monsters. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Discipline
entries.definition: Casts an aura that grants additional energy shield and increased energy shield recharge rate to you and your allies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Divine Blast
entries.definition: Project a beam of holy light from your shield to a targeted location, causing an implosion of holy energy. This energy then lingers for a short duration, before blasting outwards in a larger and more damaging explosion. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Divine Blast of Radiance
entries.definition: Project a beam of holy light from your shield to a targeted location, causing an implosion of holy energy. This energy then lingers for a short duration as an orb, periodically releasing larger explosions. Increases and reductions to attack speed affect the rate at which explosions occur. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Divine Ire
entries.definition: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages, damaging a number of nearby enemies when you do so. Release to unleash this energy in a burst around you and a beam in front of you. Modifiers to area of effect do not affect the beam. Maximum of 10 Stages. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Divine Ire of Holy Lightning
entries.definition: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages, damaging a number of nearby enemies when you do so. Release to unleash this energy in a powerful burst around you. Maximum of 10 Stages. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Divine Ire of Disintegration
entries.definition: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages. Release to unleash this energy in a beam in front of you. Modifiers to area of effect do not affect this skill. Maximum of 10 Stages. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Divine Retribution
entries.definition: Retaliate against a blocked hit with a surge of divine power, causing multiple waves of lightning bursts to expand outward from a targeted location. This skill cannot be Triggered or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Dominating Blow
entries.definition: Attacks enemies with a melee strike, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the enemy's corpse will be consumed and a Sentinel of Dominance with the same rarity, prefix and suffix modifiers will be summoned for a longer secondary duration. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Dominating Blow of Inspiring
entries.definition: Attacks enemies with a melee strike, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the enemy's corpse will be consumed and a Sentinel of Dominance with the same rarity, prefix and suffix modifiers will be summoned for a longer secondary duration. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Double Strike
entries.definition: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Double Strike of Impaling
entries.definition: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Double Strike of Momentum
entries.definition: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon, gaining stages which cause this skill to attack faster. All stages are lost when you move. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Dread Banner
entries.definition: You must gain Valour from melee combat to use this skill, which will consume all Valour to place a banner with an aura. The aura will be larger and more powerful the more Valour was consumed. The banner lasts for a duration, but will end early if you leave the aura, or use the skill again while it's active. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Dual Strike
entries.definition: Attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one strike. Dual wield only. Does not work with wands. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Dual Strike of Ambidexterity
entries.definition: Attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one strike. Requires dual-wielding two different melee weapon types to use. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Earthquake
entries.definition: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a duration. Cracks created before the first one has erupted will not generate their own aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Earthquake of Amplification
entries.definition: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a duration. Cracks created before the first one has erupted will not generate their own aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Earthshatter
entries.definition: Slam the ground, sending out rectangular fissures that deal area damage to enemies and thrust a spike from the ground when they end. Warcries or other Slam Attacks performed by you or allied players near any spike will cause them to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Earthshatter of Fragility
entries.definition: Slam the ground, sending out rectangular fissures that deal area damage to enemies and thrust a spike from the ground when they end. The spikes shatter after a duration, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Earthshatter of Prominence
entries.definition: Slam the ground, sending out a rectangular fissure that deals area damage to enemies and thrusts a large spike from the ground where it ends. Warcries or other Slam Attacks performed by you or allied players near the spike will cause it to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Elemental Hit
entries.definition: Each attack with a melee weapon will choose an element at random, and will only be able to deal damage of that element. If the attack hits an enemy, it will deal damage in an area around them, with the radius being larger if that enemy is suffering from an ailment of the chosen element. It will avoid choosing the same element twice in a row. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Elemental Hit of the Spectrum
entries.definition: Fires a projectile with a wand or bow that deals fire, cold and lightning damage. If the projectile hits an enemy, it will deal damage in an area around them. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Elemental Weakness
entries.definition: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their elemental resistances. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Enduring Cry
entries.definition: Performs a warcry, taunting all nearby enemies to attack the user and granting a buff to the user and nearby allies. The user and allied players also gain endurance charges. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Energy Blade
entries.definition: Grants a buff which significantly lowers your maximum Energy Shield to transform your equipped swords into swords formed from that energy. Casting the spell again removes the buff. This skill cannot be triggered or used with non-sword weapons. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Enfeeble
entries.definition: Curses all targets in an area, reducing their accuracy and making them deal less damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ensnaring Arrow
entries.definition: Fires an arrow that remains in the ground behind its final target, tethering that enemy to it. Ensnared enemies have less movement speed while trying to break the snare. The snare will break if they leave the area of effect. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Essence Drain
entries.definition: Fires a projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You are healed for a portion of the debuff damage. The debuff is spread by Contagion. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Essence Drain of Desperation
entries.definition: Fires a projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You lose Life and Energy Shield equal to a portion of the debuff damage. The debuff is spread by Contagion. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Essence Drain of Wickedness
entries.definition: Fires a piercing projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You are healed for a portion of the debuff damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ethereal Knives
entries.definition: Fires an arc of knives outwards in front of the caster which deal physical damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ethereal Knives of Lingering Blades
entries.definition:
Fires an arc of knives down into the ground in front of the caster which deal physical damage.
Cannot be supported by Volley. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ethereal Knives of the Massacre
entries.definition: Fires a circle of knives outwards around the caster which deal physical damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Eviscerate
entries.definition: Retaliate against a blocked hit with an arcing slash that releases two waves of force. Enemies close in front of you can be hit by both waves. Requires a Sword or Axe and a Shield. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Explosive Arrow
entries.definition: Fires an arrow which will stick into an enemy or wall, and then explode, dealing area damage around it, either after a duration or when the maximum number of arrows stuck to that target is reached. If an enemy has multiple Explosive Arrows stuck in them, the first one to explode will consume the others, adding their damage to its explosion. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Explosive Concoction
entries.definition: Throws a bottle that explodes to deal unarmed attack damage in an area. Can consume charges from your Ruby, Sapphire, and Topaz flasks to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Explosive Concoction of Destruction
entries.definition: Throws a bottle that explodes to deal unarmed attack damage in an area. Can consume charges from your Ruby, Sapphire, and Topaz flasks to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Explosive Trap
entries.definition: Throws a trap that creates an explosion when triggered, dealing spell damage in an area around it. A number of smaller explosions occur within a secondary area around the trap in quick succession after the first. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Explosive Trap of Shrapnel
entries.definition: Throws a trap that creates an explosion when triggered, dealing spell damage in an area around it. A number of smaller explosions occur within a secondary area around the trap in quick succession after the first. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Explosive Trap of Magnitude
entries.definition: Throws a trap that creates a large explosion when triggered, dealing spell damage in an area around it. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Exsanguinate
entries.definition: Releases several tendrils of blood from your character, targeting enemies in a narrow angle in front of you. The beams deal physical damage and inflict a physical damage over time debuff to enemies, which can stack up to 3 times. Effects which allow skills to chain can apply to these tendrils. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Exsanguinate of Transmission
entries.definition: Releases a tendril of blood from your character, which will target an enemy in front of you, then chain to other enemies. The tendril deals physical damage and inflicts a physical damage over time debuff to enemies, which can stack up to 3 times. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Eye of Winter
entries.definition: Fires a single eye projectile which constantly releases shard projectiles in a spiral. The shards will damage enemies they impact, dealing cold damage. The eye cannot damage enemies. When the eye dissipates or collides with terrain, it releases a faster spiral of extra shards. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Eye of Winter of Finality
entries.definition: Fires a single eye projectile which cannot damage enemies. When the eye dissipates or collides with terrain, it releases a fast spiral of shards. The shards will deal cold damage to enemies they impact. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Eye of Winter of Transience
entries.definition: Fires a single eye projectile which releases a number shard projectiles in a spiral before dissipating. The shards will damage enemies they impact, dealing cold damage. The eye cannot damage enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Fire Trap
entries.definition: Throws a trap that explodes when triggered, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies and leaving an area of burning ground that damages enemies who walk through it. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Fire Trap of Blasting
entries.definition: Throws a trap that explodes when triggered, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Fireball
entries.definition: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Firestorm
entries.definition: Flaming bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Firestorm of Meteors
entries.definition: A large flaming bolt falls towards the targeted area. The bolt explodes when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Firestorm of Pelting
entries.definition: Flaming bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Flame Dash
entries.definition: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving a trail of burning ground. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Flame Dash of Return
entries.definition: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving a trail of burning ground, then repeat the teleport in the other direction. Cannot be triggered, or used by a totem, trap or mine. Cannot be supported by Unleash. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Flame Link
entries.definition: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they deal additional fire damage based on your life. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Flame Surge
entries.definition: Strikes enemies in front of you with a surge of flame. Burning enemies are dealt more damage. If you hit an ignited enemy, will create burning ground under them. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this burning ground. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Flame Surge of Combusting
entries.definition: Strikes enemies in front of you with a surge of flame. If this ignites an enemy a large area of burning ground will be created under them. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this burning ground. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Flame Wall
entries.definition: Create a wall of fire for a duration, which deals burning damage to everything in its area. Each enemy that enters the wall also receives a secondary burning debuff which persists for a short duration after leaving the wall. Any projectiles fired through the wall by you and allies deal added fire damage and apply the wall's secondary debuff on hit. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Flameblast
entries.definition: Channels to build up a large explosion, which is released when you stop using the skill. The longer you channel, the larger the area of effect and damage of the explosion. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Flameblast of Celerity
entries.definition: Channels to build up an explosion, which is released when you stop using the skill or automatically at maximum stages. The longer you channel, the larger the area of effect and damage of the explosion. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Flameblast of Contraction
entries.definition: Channels to concentrate an explosion, which is released when you stop using the skill. The longer you channel, the larger the damage of the explosion, but the smaller the area. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Flamethrower Trap
entries.definition: Throws a trap that releases a number of flames in different directions around it when triggered. The flames last for a duration, rotating around the trap and repeatedly dealing damage. Burning enemies are dealt more damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Flamethrower Trap of Stability
entries.definition: Throws a trap that releases a number of flames in different directions around it when triggered. The flames last for a duration repeatedly dealing damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Flammability
entries.definition: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their fire resistance and giving them a chance to be ignited when hit. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Flesh and Stone
entries.definition: Buffs you, and affects nearby enemies with an aura, differently depending on your stance. Both stances are more impactful against enemies closer to you. Using the skill again alternates between Blood Stance and Sand Stance. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Flesh Offering
entries.definition: Consumes a corpse, which temporarily empowers your minions with swiftness. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Flicker Strike
entries.definition: Teleports the character to a nearby monster and attacks with a melee weapon. If no specific monster is targeted, one is picked at random. Grants a buff that increases movement speed for a duration. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Flicker Strike of Power
entries.definition: Teleports the character to a nearby monster and attacks with a melee weapon. If no specific monster is targeted, one is picked at random. Grants a buff that increases movement speed for a duration. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Power Charge. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Forbidden Rite
entries.definition: Lobs an exploding projectile near the targeted location, and extra projectiles toward enemies around you. The projectiles deal chaos damage based on your life and energy shield. Casting this spell damages you. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Forbidden Rite of Soul Sacrifice
entries.definition: Lobs an exploding projectile near the targeted location, and extra projectiles toward enemies around you. The projectiles deal chaos damage based on your energy shield. Casting this spell damages you. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Freezing Pulse
entries.definition: An icy projectile which has a chance to freeze enemies it passes through. The projectile fades quickly, reducing damage and freezing chance until it dissipates. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Frenzy
entries.definition: Performs an attack with a ranged weapon that gives the character a frenzy charge if it hits. Frenzy charges increase your attack speed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Frenzy of Onslaught
entries.definition: Perform a strike with a melee weapon that gives the character a frenzy charge if it hits. Frenzy charges increase your attack speed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Frost Blades
entries.definition: Attack enemies with increased range, releasing icy blades from the first enemy hit which fly at other enemies. Requires a Melee Weapon. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Frost Blades of Katabasis
entries.definition: Attack enemies with greatly increased range, creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time if it hits. Requires a Melee Weapon. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Frostbolt
entries.definition: Fires a slow-moving projectile that pierces through enemies, dealing cold damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Frost Bomb
entries.definition: Creates a crystal that pulses with cold for a duration. Each pulse applies a debuff to nearby enemies for a secondary duration which reduces life regeneration rate, and also inflicts Cold Exposure. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing heavy cold damage to enemies around it. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Frost Bomb of Instability
entries.definition: Creates a crystal which lasts for a duration. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing cold damage to enemies around it. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Frost Bomb of Forthcoming
entries.definition: Creates a crystal which lasts for a duration. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing heavy cold damage to enemies around it. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Frost Shield
entries.definition: Place a Frost Shield that drains your energy shield for one second or until you run out, gaining stages while this drain occurs. The Frost Shield takes some damage from hits in place of you and allies while in its area. Enemies in the area are Chilled. You can only have one Frost Shield active at once. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Frost Wall
entries.definition: Creates a wall of ice which holds back enemies. Targets under the wall are damaged and pushed back. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Frostbite
entries.definition: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their cold resistance and giving them a chance to be frozen when hit. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Frostblink
entries.definition: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving Chilled ground in an area at both ends of the teleport. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Frostblink of Wintry Blast
entries.definition: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies in an area at both ends of the teleport. Deals higher damage to chilled enemies, then removes chill from them. Cannot be supported by Unleash. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Frozen Legion
entries.definition: This spell consumes multiple cooldown uses to summon icy Statues in a ring. Each Statue uses your Frozen Sweep attack once before vanishing. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, or Staff. This skill cannot be triggered, supported by Spell Echo or Unleash, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.  This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Frozen Legion of Rallying
entries.definition: This spell consumes multiple cooldown uses to summon icy Statues in a ring. Each Statue uses your Frozen Sweep attack once before vanishing. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, or Staff. This skill cannot be triggered, supported by Spell Echo or Unleash, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.  This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Galvanic Arrow
entries.definition: Fire a trio of electrical arrows that quickly dissipate, vanishing shortly after being loosed. The arrows are fired with such force that they create a burst of lightning, damaging enemies in a cone in front of you. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Galvanic Arrow of Energy
entries.definition: Create a burst of lightning from your Bow, firing no arrows but damaging enemies in a cone in front of you. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Galvanic Arrow of Surging
entries.definition: Fire a trio of electrical arrows that quickly dissipate, vanishing shortly after being loosed. If the arrows' flight is stopped by colliding with a target, they create a burst of lightning, damaging enemies in a cone behind the target This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Galvanic Field
entries.definition: Applies a buff boosting chance to shock. When you shock an enemy while you have this buff, creates a spherical field of energy attached to the shocked enemy for a duration, which will damage it and other nearby enemies with beams of lightning. The strength of the field depends on the magnitude of shock affecting the enemy when it is created.
