This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Galvanic Field of Intensity
entries.definition: Applies a buff boosting chance to shock. When you shock an enemy while you have this buff, creates a spherical field of energy attached to the shocked enemy for a duration, which will damage it and other nearby enemies with beams of lightning. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Detonate Mines
entries.definition: Detonates a Mine, starting a Detonation Sequence which will detonate other Mines around it. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: General's Cry
entries.definition: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user, and summoning Mirage Warriors from nearby corpses. The Mirage Warriors each use a linked attack skill once before dissipating. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Glacial Cascade
entries.definition: Icicles emerge from the ground in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area and knocking them back in the direction of the next burst. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Glacial Cascade of the Fissure
entries.definition: Icicles emerge from the ground in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Glacial Hammer
entries.definition: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to cold damage. If a non-unique enemy is frozen and is on less than one third life, they will shatter when hit by Glacial Hammer. If striking three times in a row, the third strike will freeze enemies more easily. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Glacial Hammer of Shattering
entries.definition: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to cold damage. If striking three times in a row, the third strike will be a critical strike. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Glacial Shield Swipe
entries.definition: Retaliate against a blocked hit with a sweep of your Shield, unleashing a wave of ice in a cone in front of you. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Grace
entries.definition: Casts an aura that grants evasion to you and your allies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ground Slam
entries.definition: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wave that travels forward and damages enemies with an increased chance to stun. The wave deals more damage to closer enemies. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ground Slam of Earthshaking
entries.definition: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wide wave that travels forward and damages enemies with an increased chance to stun. Requires a Two Handed Axe, Two Handed Mace, or Staff. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Haste
entries.definition: Casts an aura that increases the movement speed, attack speed and cast speed of you and your allies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Hatred
entries.definition: Casts an aura that grants extra cold damage based on physical damage to you and your allies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Heavy Strike
entries.definition: Attacks enemies with a forceful blow. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Sword or Staff. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Heavy Strike of Trarthus
entries.definition: Attacks enemies with a forceful blow. Requires a Staff. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Herald of Agony
entries.definition: Grants a buff giving more poison damage and a chance to inflict poison. When you poison an enemy while you have this buff, you gain Virulence, and summon an Agony Crawler minion that uses projectile and area attacks. You will lose Virulence over time, at a rate which increases the more Virulence you have. The minion will die when you have no Virulence. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Herald of Ash
entries.definition: Grants a buff providing fire damage based on your physical damage. While you have this buff, if you kill an enemy, other enemies near them will be burned based on the overkill damage. The burn inflicted by this skill can only be affected by modifiers to damage over time (burning damage is damage over time). This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Herald of Ice
entries.definition: Grants a buff adding cold damage to spells and attacks. If you shatter an enemy, this skill will cause them to explode and deal AoE cold damage to enemies near them. This damage is not affected by modifiers to spell damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Herald of Purity
entries.definition: Grants a buff which lets you deal more physical damage. When you kill an enemy while you have this buff, this skill will summon a Sentinel of Purity, or refresh the duration and life of an existing one instead if you have the maximum number of them. The Sentinels of Purity have a single-target melee attack and an area melee attack. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Herald of Thunder
entries.definition: Grants a buff which adds lightning damage to spells and attacks. If you kill a shocked enemy, this skill will create a storm, causing lightning bolts to strike enemies around you for a duration. The damage inflicted by this skill is not affected by modifiers to spell damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Hexblast
entries.definition: Deals chaos damage to a single enemy, dealing more damage if they are Hexed, then removing the Hex. If the enemy was Hexed, also deals area damage to other enemies around the target, boosting damage and removing Hexes from those enemies in the same way. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Hexblast of Contradiction
entries.definition: Deals chaos damage to a single enemy, dealing more damage if they are Hexed, then removing the Hex. If the enemy was Hexed, also deals area damage to other enemies around the target, boosting damage and removing Hexes from those enemies in the same way. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Hexblast of Havoc
entries.definition: Deals chaos damage to a single enemy. If the enemy was Hexed, also deals area damage to other enemies around the target. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Holy Flame Totem
entries.definition: Summons a totem that channels to fire a stream of flame at nearby enemies, and creates an area of consecrated ground around the totem. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Holy Flame Totem of Ire
entries.definition: Summons a totem that channels to fire a stream of flame at nearby enemies, and creates an area of consecrated ground around the totem. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Holy Hammers
entries.definition: Slam the ground, calling down a Holy Hammer from above. On hitting an enemy, another Hammer will cascade forward, repeating if further enemies are hit, up to a cap. A Power Charge can be expended to call down additional Hammers to either side of the initial slam. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Holy Hammers of Spirals
entries.definition: Slam the ground, consuming all Power Charges and calling down a cascade of holy hammers from above in an outward spiral. Further hammers are called down for each Power Charge consumed. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Holy Strike
entries.definition: Infuse your weapon with holy energy and swing. Successfully hitting an enemy will summon forth a copy of your Main Hand weapon as a Holy Armament. These Holy Armaments are undamageable minions, and will attack the enemies you target with Holy Strike. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Hydrosphere
entries.definition: Create a sphere of water, or move an existing sphere and reset its duration. The sphere continually applies a drenched debuff with a short duration to enemies in its area or those it moves through. You can hit the sphere with other skills to inflict Cold and Lightning Ailments (other than Chill). The sphere pulses when created, at regular intervals while afflicted by an Ailment, and after moving, damaging all drenched enemies in a large area. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ice Crash
entries.definition: Slam the ground, damaging enemies in an area around the impact in three stages of increasing size. Enemies take slightly less damage on the second and third stage, and can only be hit by one stage. Works with Swords, Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ice Crash of Cadence
entries.definition: Slam the ground, damaging enemies in an area. Slams with main hand weapon deal more damage. Slams with off hand weapon have larger area of effect. Requires dual-wielding Swords, Maces, Sceptres, or Axes to use. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ice Nova
entries.definition: A circle of ice expands from the caster. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ice Nova of Frostbolts
entries.definition: A circle of ice expands from the caster. If the caster targets near their Frostbolt projectiles, it will expand from a number of those projectiles instead. If this skill would repeat when cast this way, it will instead expand again from the same projectiles after a short delay. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ice Nova of Deep Freeze
entries.definition: A circle of ice expands from the caster. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ice Shot
entries.definition: Fires an arrow that converts some physical damage to cold on its target and converts all physical damage to cold in a cone behind that target. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ice Shot of Penetration
entries.definition: Fires a piercing arrow that converts some physical damage to cold on its target and converts all physical damage to cold in two cones perpendicular to the target. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ice Spear
entries.definition: Launches shards of ice in rapid succession. After travelling a short distance they change to a second form, which moves much faster and pierces through enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ice Spear of Splitting
entries.definition: Launches a shard of ice that splits on hitting terrain or enemies. After splitting, the projectiles are in second form, which moves much faster and pierces through enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ice Trap
entries.definition: Throws a trap that creates a series of icy runic explosions when triggered, dealing cold damage to all enemies caught in the blasts. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ice Trap of Hollowness
entries.definition: Throws a trap that creates a series of icy runic explosions in a circle around itself when triggered, dealing cold damage to all enemies caught in the blasts. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Icicle Mine
entries.definition: Throws a mine that fires projectiles around it when detonated. These projectiles quickly dissipate as they travel, before disappearing. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Icicle Mine of Fanning
entries.definition: Throws a mine that fires projectiles at enemies when detonated. These projectiles quickly dissipate as they travel, before disappearing. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Icicle Mine of Sabotage
entries.definition: Throws a mine that fires projectiles around it when detonated. These projectiles quickly dissipate as they travel, before disappearing. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Immortal Call
entries.definition: Take less Physical and Elemental Damage for a short time. Consumes up to 5 Endurance Charges to lengthen the buff and further lessen Physical Damage taken. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Incinerate
entries.definition: Continuously launches a torrent of fire from your hand, repeatedly damaging enemies. As you channel this spell longer, the flames spread wider close to you and spread longer directly in front of you. When you stop channelling you release a wave of fire damage over a wide and long area that will apply a powerful Ignite. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Incinerate of Expanse
entries.definition: Continuously launches a torrent of fire from your hand, repeatedly damaging enemies. As you channel this spell longer, the flames spread wider close to you and spread longer directly in front of you. When you stop channelling you release a slow-moving wave of fire damage over a very large area that will apply a powerful Ignite. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Incinerate of Venting
entries.definition: Continuously launches a torrent of fire from your hand, repeatedly damaging enemies. As you channel this spell longer, the flames spread wider close to you and spread longer directly in front of you. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Infernal Blow
entries.definition: Attacks with your weapon, applying a charged debuff to enemies hit by your strike, and an uncharged debuff to any other enemies hit. Upon reaching 6 charges, expiring, or the enemy's death, the charged debuff is removed to damage that and other surrounding enemies. Enemies with either debuff explode when they die, damaging other surrounding enemies. Damage from this explosion cannot be reflected. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Infernal Blow of Immolation
entries.definition: Attacks with your weapon, applying a charged debuff to you the first time you hit an enemy with this skill. Upon reaching 6 charges, or charges expiring, the charged debuff is removed to damage nearby enemies. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Infernal Cry
entries.definition: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that grants a portion of their physical damage as extra fire damage. In addition to being taunted, enemies are inflicted with a secondary debuff causing them to explode when they die, dealing fire damage in an area. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Intimidating Cry
entries.definition: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that grants movement speed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Intuitive Link
entries.definition: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, their hits can trigger your supported spells. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Kinetic Blast
entries.definition: Fires a projectile from a Wand that causes a series of area explosions in a secondary radius around its point of impact, each damaging enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Kinetic Blast of Clustering
entries.definition: Fires a projectile from a Wand that causes a series of area explosions in a secondary radius around its point of impact, each damaging enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Kinetic Bolt
entries.definition: Fire a projectile from your wand that changes direction in a zig-zag pattern at regular intervals or when hitting enemies. Each time it changes direction, a secondary projectile breaks off, flying in the direction it changed away from. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Kinetic Bolt of Fragmentation
entries.definition: Fire a projectile from your wand that changes direction in a zig-zag pattern at regular intervals or when hitting enemies. Each time it changes direction, a secondary projectile breaks off, flying in the direction it changed away from. Multiple of these projectiles can hit the same target. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Kinetic Fusillade
entries.definition: Wave your wand to create a hovering kinetic projectile. After a short duration, the projectile is fired at an enemy, dealing area damage on impact and chaining to further targets. Using this attack again will reset the duration for all hovering projectiles. Multiple projectiles fired in sequence will attempt to target different enemies. Cannot be directly used by traps or mines. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Kinetic Fusillade of Detonation
entries.definition: Wave your wand to create multiple hovering kinetic projectiles. After a short duration, the projectiles explode, dealing area damage. Using this attack again will reset the duration for all hovering projectiles. Cannot be directly used by traps or mines. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Kinetic Rain
entries.definition: Swing your wand to cause a number of projectiles to rain down within a large area in front of you, directly targeting the locations of enemies in the area. The locations where each projectile will land are shown with markers before they fall. Each projectile explodes when hitting the ground, dealing area damage and triggering Kinetic Anomaly. Cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Kinetic Rain of Impact
entries.definition: Swing your wand to cause a number of projectiles to rain down within a large area in front of you, directly targeting the locations of enemies in the area. The locations where each projectile will land are shown with markers before they fall. Each projectile explodes when hitting the ground, dealing area damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Lacerate
entries.definition: Slashes twice, releasing waves of force that damage enemies they hit. Enemies in the middle of the slashes can be hit by both. The slashes will have a chance to inflict bleeding in Blood Stance, or have a wider angle in Sand Stance. Can be used with Axes and Swords. You are in Blood Stance by default. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Lacerate of Butchering
entries.definition: Slashes twice, releasing wide waves of force that damage enemies they hit. Enemies in the middle of the slashes can be hit by both. Requires a Two Handed Axe or Two Handed Sword. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Lacerate of Haemorrhage
entries.definition: Slashes twice, releasing waves of force that damage enemies they hit. Enemies in the middle of the slashes can be hit by both. Requires a One Handed Axe or One Handed Sword. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Lancing Steel
entries.definition: Thrust an Axe or Sword forward, consuming your Steel Shards to form a cluster of shards in front of you. The cluster will fire a number of projectiles in sequence, aiming at enemies in front of or close to it. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Lancing Steel of Spraying
entries.definition: Thrust an Axe or Sword forward to form a cluster of shards in front of you. The cluster will fire a number of projectiles in sequence, aiming at enemies in front of or close to it. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Leap Slam
entries.definition: Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Leap Slam of Groundbreaking
entries.definition: Jump a short distance through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Lightning Arrow
entries.definition: Fires a charged arrow which damages enemies by causing them to be struck by a bolt of lightning, which also damages a number of surrounding enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Lightning Arrow of Electrocution
entries.definition: Fires a charged arrow which damages enemies by causing them to be struck by a bolt of lightning. It sticks into the final target, causing them to be struck and damaged multiple times. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Lightning Conduit
entries.definition: Lightning strikes all Shocked enemies around a targeted location, then removes Shock from those enemies. Shocks cannot expire on enemies in range while casting this spell. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade or Unleash. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Lightning Conduit of the Heavens
entries.definition: Lightning strikes a number of enemies around a targeted location. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Lightning Spire Trap
entries.definition: Throws a trap which, once triggered, will repeatedly strike multiple areas around it for a duration, dealing lightning damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Lightning Spire Trap of Zapping
entries.definition: Throws a trap which, once triggered, will repeatedly strike multiple areas around it for a duration, dealing lightning damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Lightning Spire Trap of Overloading
entries.definition: Throws a trap which, once triggered, will repeatedly strike multiple areas around it for a duration, dealing lightning damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Lightning Strike
entries.definition: Infuses your melee weapon with electrical energies as you swing. In addition to converting some of your physical damage to lightning damage, the stored energy is released from the weapon as projectiles as you strike, flying out to hit farther-away enemies. The projectiles cannot miss if the melee attack hit a target. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Lightning Strike of Arcing
entries.definition: Infuses your melee weapon with electrical energies as you swing. In addition to converting some of your physical damage to lightning damage, the stored energy is released from the weapon as a projectile as you strike, flying out to hit farther-away enemies and chain between them. The projectile cannot miss if the melee attack hit a target. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Lightning Tendrils
entries.definition: While you channel this skill, it releases pulses of electrical energy, dealing lightning damage in a semicircular area in front of you. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Lightning Tendrils of Eccentricity
entries.definition: While you channel this skill, it releases pulses of electrical energy, dealing lightning damage in a semicircular area in front of you. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Lightning Tendrils of Escalation
entries.definition: While you channel this skill, it releases pulses of electrical energy, dealing lightning damage in a growing semicircular area in front of you. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Lightning Trap
entries.definition: Throws a trap that launches a ring of projectiles through the enemy that set it off, dealing lightning damage to them and subsequent targets. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Lightning Trap of Sparking
entries.definition: Throws a trap that launches projectiles through the enemy that set it off, dealing lightning damage to them and subsequent targets. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Lightning Warp
entries.definition: Waits for a duration before teleporting to a targeted destination, with the duration based on the distance and your movement speed. When the teleport occurs, lightning damage is dealt to the area around both where the player was and where they teleported to. Casting again will queue up multiple teleportations to occur in sequence. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Malevolence
entries.definition: Casts an aura that multiplies damage over time and increases skill effect duration of you and your allies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Mana-Infused Staff
entries.definition: Infuses your staff with arcane energy, lowering your mana costs and increasing your chance to block. When you block, you release an arcane wave, damaging enemies in a ring-shaped area over a duration. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Manabond
entries.definition: Deals lightning damage based upon your missing mana in a circular area around the targeted location, as well as in four rectangular extensions whose lengths depend upon your remaining mana. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Mirror Arrow
entries.definition: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Mirror Arrow of Bombarding Clones
entries.definition: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire arrows into the air to land around a target. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Mirror Arrow of Prismatic Clones
entries.definition: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire random elemental arrows which convert all physical damage to the chosen element and deal no damage of other damage types. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Molten Shell
entries.definition: Applies a buff that adds to your armour, and can take some of the damage from hits for you before being depleted. When the buff expires or is depleted, the skill deals reflected damage to enemies around you based on the total damage that was taken from the buff. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Molten Strike
entries.definition: Infuses your melee weapon with molten energies to attack with physical and fire damage. This attack causes balls of molten magma to launch forth from the enemies you hit, divided amongst all enemies hit by the strike. These will deal area attack damage to enemies where they land. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Molten Strike of the Zenith
entries.definition: Infuses your two-handed melee weapon with molten energies to attack with physical and fire damage. This attack causes balls of molten magma to launch forth from the enemies you hit, divided amongst all enemies hit by the strike. These will deal area attack damage to enemies where they land. Every fifth time you attack with this skill it fires more, high-damage projectiles. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Orb of Storms
entries.definition: Creates a stationary electrical orb that strikes enemies in its area of effect with beams of lightning that can then split to hit more enemies. Modifiers to cast speed will increase how frequently it does this. Casting this skill again will replace the previous orb. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Orb of Storms of Squalls
entries.definition: Creates an electrical orb that will strike enemies in its area of effect with beams of lightning when placed, as well as when you use a lightning skill while within its area. These beams of lightning can then split to hit more enemies. When striking enemies, this orb will teleport to a random enemy struck. Casting this skill again will replace the previous orb. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Pact of Beidat
entries.definition: Cast a pact, Empowering non-channelling spells that either fire projectiles, apply an effect to an area around a targeted location or fire chaining beams, causing them to deal more damage and have enhanced coverage. However, using this skill also burdens you with an Affliction. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Pact of Ghorr
entries.definition: Cast a pact, Empowering your damage over time spells but burdening you with an Affliction. This skill also grants the Hunger of Ghorr buff for a duration causing Fleshrend to trigger periodically. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Pact of K'Tash
entries.definition: Cast a pact, Empowering your damaging Vaal spells but burdening you with an Affliction. Empowered Vaal spells deal more damage, have less soul gain prevention duration and regain consumed souls on use. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Pact of Lycia
entries.definition: Cast a pact, Empowering the next channelling spells you cast yourself but burdening you with an Affliction. Empowered spells deal more damage and periodically trigger lightning bolts while channelling. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Penance Brand
entries.definition: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy. When the branded enemy reaches 20 energy, a large explosion occurs and the brand is removed. All energy is removed from the enemy when the brand is detached. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Penance Brand of Dissipation
entries.definition: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy and causing a pulse that deals damage to the branded enemy and other nearby enemies. The pulse gains area of effect and damage for each energy on the branded enemy, up to 20. All energy is removed from the enemy when the brand is detached. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Penance Brand of Conduction
entries.definition: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy and nearby enemies who do not have energy. When the brand is detached, all enemies with energy are dealt damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Perforate
entries.definition: Smash the ground to bring forth multiple spears to damage enemies. When in Blood Stance, multiple spikes burst from the ground in sequence, able to hit enemies multiple times. In Sand Stance, the spikes are thrust outwards. Requires a Sword or Axe. You are in Blood Stance by default. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Perforate of Duality
entries.definition: Smash the ground to bring forth multiple spears to damage enemies. When in Blood Stance, multiple spikes burst from the ground in sequence, able to hit enemies multiple times. In Sand Stance, the spikes are thrust outwards. Requires a Sword or Axe. You are in Blood Stance by default. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Perforate of Bloodshed
entries.definition:
Smash the ground to bring forth multiple spikes from the ground in sequence, able to hit enemies multiple times.
Requires a Sword or Axe. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Pestilent Strike
entries.definition: Attacks with your weapon, inflicting a debuff on enemies hit by the strike. If a debuffed enemy dies while poisoned, Pestilent Strike inflicts a secondary chaos damage over time debuff on enemies around them, based on the poisons on the slain enemy. This damage is not affected by your damage modifiers. Requires a Claw or Dagger. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Petrified Blood
entries.definition: Applies a buff that protects the lower half of your life, preventing some of the immediate life loss when damaged by hits and applying the loss over time instead. Your life cannot be raised above low life other than by flasks, and while above low life, skills will cost life as well as mana. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Phase Run
entries.definition: Gain a buff that makes you faster, harder to detect, and grants Phasing, letting you pass through enemies. Performing any skill replaces this buff with one that boosts melee physical damage of skills you use yourself (it will not apply to your melee skills used by totems). Consumes Frenzy Charges to increase duration. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Plague Bearer
entries.definition: Gain an Incubating buff, adding to its Plague Value as you inflict poisons. Use the skill again to begin Infecting, dealing chaos damage over time to nearby enemies until the Plague Value is depleted. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this skill's damage. Using the skill again alternates between Incubating and Infecting. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Poacher's Mark
entries.definition: Curses a single enemy, lowering their physical damage reduction, and adding physical damage to all hits against them. Attacking the cursed enemy will grant life and mana, and killing them will grant a frenzy charge. You can only have one Mark at a time. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Poisonous Concoction
entries.definition: Throws a bottle that explodes to deal unarmed attack damage in an area and has a chance to poison. Can consume charges from a Life flask to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Poisonous Concoction of Bouncing
entries.definition: Throws a single bottle that releases a burst when it hits the ground, dealing unarmed attack damage in an area with a chance to poison. The skill chains, bouncing randomly to deal damage multiple times. Can consume charges from a Life flask to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Portal
entries.definition: Creates a portal to the current area's town. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Power Siphon
entries.definition: Fires your wand to fire a single projectile each at a number of nearby enemies, granting you a power charge if an enemy is killed by, or soon after, the hit. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Power Siphon of the Archmage
entries.definition: Fires your wand to fire a single projectile each at a number of nearby enemies, granting you a power charge if an enemy is killed by, or soon after, the hit. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Precision
entries.definition: Casts an aura that grants accuracy and critical strike chance to you and your allies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Pride
entries.definition: Casts an aura that causes nearby enemies to take more physical damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Protective Link
entries.definition: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they copy your block chance and recover life when they block. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Puncture
entries.definition: Punctures enemies with your Bow, causing a bleeding debuff, which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Puncture of Shanking
entries.definition: Punctures enemies, causing a bleeding debuff, which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. Puncture works with daggers, claws or swords. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Punishment
entries.definition: Curses all targets in an area, causing them to be debilitated when they hit enemies and increasing damage they take while on low life. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Purifying Flame
entries.definition: A wave of divine fire deals damage in a line, then creates Consecrated Ground and deals damage in an area around the targeted location. A larger shockwave then expands outwards, damaging enemies standing on Consecrated Ground that were not already hit. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Purifying Flame of Revelations
entries.definition: A wave of divine fire deals damage in a line, then creates Consecrated Ground and deals damage in an area around the targeted location. A larger shockwave then expands outwards, damaging enemies standing on Consecrated Ground that were not already hit. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Purity of Elements
entries.definition: Casts an aura that grants elemental resistances and elemental ailment immunity to you and your allies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Purity of Fire
entries.definition: Casts an aura that grants fire resistance to you and your allies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Purity of Ice
entries.definition: Casts an aura that grants cold resistance to you and your allies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Purity of Lightning
entries.definition: Casts an aura that grants lightning resistance to you and your allies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Pyroclast Mine
entries.definition: Throws a mine that deals damage in an area when detonated, then launches fiery projectiles that rain down around it, each exploding to deal damage in a smaller area. Placed mines apply a fire exposure aura to nearby enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Pyroclast Mine of Sabotage
entries.definition: Throws a mine that deals damage in an area when detonated, then launches fiery projectiles that rain down around it, each exploding to deal damage in a smaller area. Placed mines apply a fire exposure aura to nearby enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Steelskin
entries.definition: Applies a buff which can take some of the damage from hits for you before being depleted. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Quickstep
entries.definition: Performs a series of quick teleports towards a targeted location, stopping if you would overlap with monsters or terrain. If using the "Attack in Place" option, the direction is reversed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills. Cannot be supported. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Rage Vortex
entries.definition: Spin with a sword or axe to deal damage in an area around you. Sacrifices some rage to send a ragestorm forward. While enemies are inside it, the ragestorm will slow its movement and repeatedly deal attack damage based on your attack speed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Rage Vortex of Berserking
entries.definition: Spin with a sword or axe to deal damage in an area around you. If you have at least 10 rage, create a ragestorm attached to you that repeatedly deals attack damage to enemies inside based on your attack speed. The ragestorm consumes rage at an accelerating rate, and ends if you run out. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Rain of Arrows
entries.definition: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to land in sequence after a delay, starting at the targeted location and spreading outwards in all directions. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it. Half of the arrows will land directly on targets if there are targets in their range. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Rain of Arrows of Artillery
entries.definition: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to land in sequence after a delay, starting in front of you and proceeding in a line in the direction of the target. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Rain of Arrows of Saturation
entries.definition: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to slowly land in sequence after a delay, starting at the targeted location and spreading outwards in all directions. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it. Half of the arrows will land directly on targets if there are targets in their range. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Raise Spectre
entries.definition: Raises a spectral version of a defeated foe as a minion to fight for you in battle. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Raise Spectre of Transience
entries.definition: Raises a spectral version of a defeated foe as a temporary minion to fight for you in battle for a duration. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Raise Zombie
entries.definition: Raises a zombie minion from a corpse, which will follow you and attack enemies with a melee strike. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Raise Zombie of Slamming
entries.definition: Raises a zombie minion from a corpse, which will follow you and attack enemies with a melee strike and an area of effect slam. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Raise Zombie of Falling
entries.definition: Raises necromantic energies into the sky above a targeted location, where they coalesce into a zombie minion. The minion then attacks by falling to the ground, causing an impact that deals damage in an area. The zombie cannot survive the impact. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Rallying Cry
entries.definition: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. Nearby allies gain a buff based on the damage of your weapon. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Reap
entries.definition: A bloody scythe swipes across a selected area, applying a physical damage over time debuff and hitting enemies with physical damage. If any survive, you gain a blood charge which raises the damage and cost of the skill. Players can have 5 maximum blood charges. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Reap of Butchery
entries.definition: A bloody scythe swipes around you, applying a physical damage over time debuff and hitting enemies with physical damage. If any survive, you gain a blood charge which raises the damage and cost of the skill. Players can have 5 maximum blood charges. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Reave
entries.definition: Attacks an area in front of you. Each Reave that hits an enemy grants stages, which you will begin to lose after a short period without hitting anything. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Reave of Refraction
entries.definition: Attacks an area in front of you. Each Reave that hits an enemy grants stages, which you will begin to lose after a short period without hitting anything. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Rejuvenation Totem
entries.definition: Summons a totem that has an aura which regenerates life for you and your nearby allies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Righteous Fire
entries.definition: Engulfs you in magical fire that rapidly burns you and nearby enemies. Your spell damage is substantially increased while under this effect. The effect ends when you have 1 life remaining. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Righteous Fire of Arcane Devotion
entries.definition: Engulfs you in magical fire that rapidly burns you and nearby enemies. Your cast speed is substantially increased while under this effect. The effect ends when you have 1 life remaining. Requires mana. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Rolling Magma
entries.definition: Lob a fiery orb that deals area damage as it hits the ground. The skill chains, bouncing forward to deal damage multiple times. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Scorching Ray
entries.definition: Unleash a beam of fire that burns enemies it touches. Remaining in the beam raises the burning, adding a portion of the beam's damage in stages. Inflicts Fire Exposure at maximum stages. Enemies who leave the beam continue to burn for a duration. Increasing cast speed also increases the rate at which the beam turns. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Scorching Ray of Immolation
entries.definition: Unleash a beam of fire that burns enemies it touches. Remaining in the beam raises the burning, adding a portion of the beam's damage in stages. Enemies who leave the beam continue to burn for a duration. Increasing cast speed also increases the rate at which the beam turns. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Scourge Arrow
entries.definition: Channel to infuse an arrow with chaos, gaining stages while it is held. Release to fire it, leaving spore pods in its wake. Each spore pod blooms, firing thorn arrows, which travel for a short time before dissipating. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will only apply to the initial arrows, and the spore pods will be divided between those arrows. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Scourge Arrow of Menace
entries.definition: Fire an arrow that leaves a spore pod in its wake. The spore pod blooms, firing thorn arrows, which travel for a short time before dissipating. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will only apply to the initial arrows, each of which leaves its own spore pod. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Searing Bond
entries.definition: Summons a totem that casts a beam of fire at you and each other totem you control, dealing burning damage to enemies caught in the beam. Enemies near either end of a beam also suffer burning damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Searing Bond of Detonation
entries.definition: Summons a totem that casts a beam of fire at you and each other totem you control, dealing burning damage to enemies caught in the beam. Enemies near either end of a beam also suffer burning damage. Reaching maximum active totem count will cause all totems from this skill to detonate, applying the same burning damage for a duration.  This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Seismic Cry
entries.definition: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent slam attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that increases their armour and stun threshold. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Seismic Trap
entries.definition: Throws a trap which, once triggered, repeatedly releases a number of waves for a duration. Each wave deals damage in a series of small bursts in a line, ending with a larger burst. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Seismic Trap of Swells
entries.definition: Throws a trap which, once triggered, releases a number of waves. Each wave deals damage in a series of small bursts in a line, ending with a larger burst. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Shattering Steel
entries.definition: Swing an Axe or Sword, firing projectiles which shatter on impact or soon after being launched, dealing area damage in front of where they shatter. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Shattering Steel of Ammunition
entries.definition: Swing an Axe or Sword, consuming Steel Shards to gain a Steel Ward that protects you for a duration, and fire projectiles which shatter on impact or soon after being launched, dealing area damage in front of where they shatter. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Shield Charge
entries.definition: Charges at a targeted location or enemy, pushing away enemies in your path and repeatedly dealing off-hand damage in a small area in front of you. You deal damage in a larger area when you reach the target. The further you travel, the more damage you deal, and the greater your chance of stunning enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Shield Crush
entries.definition: Swipe your shield, dealing area damage in three waves in front of you. Enemies can be hit by two of the waves where they overlap. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Shield Crush of the Chieftain
entries.definition: Swipe your shield, dealing area damage in three waves in front of you. Enemies can be hit by two of the waves where they overlap. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Shield of Light
entries.definition: Retaliate against a blocked hit with a sweep of your Shield, unleashing a wave of light in a cone in front of you. Additional waves will also emanate from allies in a radius around the first target struck, towards that target. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Shock Nova
entries.definition: Casts a ring of Lightning around you, followed by a larger Lightning nova. Each effect hits enemies caught in their area with Lightning Damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Shock Nova of Procession
entries.definition: Casts a ring of Lightning around you, followed by a larger Lightning nova. Each effect hits enemies caught in their area with Lightning Damage. This then repeats, with each repeat offset from the previous in the direction you target. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Shockwave Totem
entries.definition: Summons a totem that shakes the earth around it, knocking back and damaging nearby enemies This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Shockwave Totem of Authority
entries.definition: Summons a totem that shakes the earth around you, damaging enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Shrapnel Ballista
entries.definition: Summons a ballista totem that fires multiple arrows with extreme force, breaking them apart into shrapnel. Enemies can be hit by multiple arrows from the same attack. Requires a Bow. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Shrapnel Ballista of Steel
entries.definition: Summons a ballista totem that consumes your Steel Shards to fire multiple arrows with extreme force, breaking them apart into shrapnel. Enemies can be hit by multiple arrows from the same attack. Requires a Bow. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Siege Ballista
entries.definition: Summons a ballista totem that attacks with piercing arrows. Requires a Bow. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Siege Ballista of Splintering
entries.definition:
Summons a ballista totem that attacks with forking arrows.
Requires a Bow. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Siege Ballista of Trarthus
entries.definition: Summons a ring of ballista totems around a targeted location. These ballistae fire once at the targeted location and then expire. Requires a Bow. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Sigil of Power
entries.definition: Places a Sigil on the ground, which grants a buff to you and allies in the area around it for a duration. The Sigil gains stages as you spend mana in its area, making the buff more powerful. You can only have one Sigil of Power at a time. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Siphoning Trap
entries.definition: Throws a trap that applies debuff beams to a number of nearby enemies for a duration. The beams chill enemies and deal cold damage over time. A beam is also applied to you, granting life and mana regeneration based on the number of debuff beams affecting enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Siphoning Trap of Pain
entries.definition: Throws a trap that applies debuff beams to a number of nearby enemies for a duration. The beams chill enemies and deal cold damage over time. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Smite
entries.definition: Performs a melee attack, and causes lightning to strike a nearby enemy, dealing damage in an area. Each target can only be hit once by this skill. Hitting an enemy grants an aura for a duration. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Smite of Divine Judgement
entries.definition: Performs a melee attack, and causes lightning to strike nearby enemies, dealing damage in an area. Each target can only be hit once by this skill. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Smoke Mine
entries.definition: Throws a mine that will teleport you to it when detonated. It covers both your escape and arrival with a cloud of smoke that blinds enemies, and gives you a temporary buff to movement speed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Snipe
entries.definition: Channel to charge up your bow, gaining stages. Release to trigger one supported bow skill for each stage gained. If there are no supported skills, but at least one stage was gained, this skill will fire its own arrow instead. Cannot be used by Totems. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Sniper's Mark
entries.definition: Curses a single enemy, increasing the damage they take from projectiles, and making projectiles split when hitting them, to hit other targets around them. You can only have one Mark at a time. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Somatic Shell
entries.definition: Fire a damaging projectile from your wand which aims itself towards an enemy and applies a shell to the first enemy struck. Damage from hits against that target is taken from the shell first. If fully depleted, the shell will explode, dealing area damage and firing a projectile at another target to apply a new shell to it. If multiple projectiles are fired by an exploding shell, only the first one to hit a target can apply a shell. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Soul Link
entries.definition: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, your Energy Shield will intercept some of the damage they would take. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Soulrend
entries.definition: Fires a projectile that turns towards enemies in front of it, damaging and piercing through those it hits, and leeching some of that damage as energy shield. As the projectile travels, it repeatedly applies a short but powerful chaos damage over time debuff to each enemy in an area around it. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Soulrend of Reaping
entries.definition: Fires a projectile that deals chaos damage to enemies it hits and leeches some of that damage as energy shield. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Soulrend of the Spiral
entries.definition: Fires a series of projectiles in a spiral that turn towards enemies in front of them, damaging and piercing through those they hit, and leeching some of that damage as energy shield. As the projectiles travel, they repeatedly apply a short but powerful chaos damage over time debuff to each enemy in an area around them. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Spark
entries.definition: Launches unpredictable sparks that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Spark of the Nova
entries.definition: Launches unpredictable sparks in all directions that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Spark of Unpredictability
entries.definition: Launches unpredictable sparks with that move randomly with large differences in speed and distance until they hit an enemy or expire. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Spectral Helix
entries.definition: Throws a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It spins around while flying in a large spiral, damaging enemies in its path, and bouncing if it collides with walls. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Spectral Helix of Trarthus
entries.definition: Throws a trap which, once triggered, fires a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It spins around while flying in a large spiral, damaging enemies in its path, and bouncing if it collides with walls. If dual wielding, each Trap thrown will randomly use either the main hand or off hand weapon. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Spectral Shield Throw
entries.definition: Throws a spectral copy of your shield as a projectile which cannot pierce, and deals off-hand damage augmented by the defences of the shield. When it collides with something it will shatter, launching a number of smaller shards as projectiles in all directions. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will add more shards, not more copies of the shield. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Spectral Shield Throw of Shattering
entries.definition: Throws a spectral copy of your shield as a projectile which cannot pierce, and deals off-hand damage augmented by the evasion of the shield. When it collides with something it will shatter, launching a number of smaller shards as projectiles in all directions. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will add more shards, not more copies of the shield. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Spectral Shield Throw of Trarthus
entries.definition: Throws a spectral copy of your shield as a piercing projectile which deals off-hand damage augmented by the defences of the shield. When it reaches the targeted location it will hover in place, repeatedly firing a number of smaller shards as projectiles in all directions. The rate at which it releases shards will increase until all shards have been fired. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will add more shards, not more copies of the shield. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Spectral Throw
entries.definition: Throws a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It flies out and then returns to you, in a spinning attack that damages enemies in its path. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Spectral Throw of Materialising
entries.definition: Throws an intangible spectral copy of your melee weapon. It flies out and then becomes tangible as it returns to you, in a spinning attack that only hits and damages enemies while returning. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Spectral Throw of Trarthus
entries.definition: Throws a trap which, once triggered, fires many spectral copies of your melee weapon. They fly out in all directions and then return to where the trap triggered, in a spinning attack that damages enemies in their path. If dual wielding, each Trap thrown will randomly use either the main hand or off hand weapon. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Spellslinger
entries.definition: Reserves mana based on the supported spells to cause those spells to trigger when you fire projectiles from a wand attack. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Spirit Offering
entries.definition: Consumes a corpse, granting increased critical strike chance and additional critical strike multiplier to your minions. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Split Arrow
entries.definition: Fires multiple arrows at different targets. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Split Arrow of Splitting
entries.definition: Fires an arrow that splits to hit different targets. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Splitting Steel
entries.definition: Fire a single projectile that splits on impact or at the targeted location, dealing area damage when it splits and again when the split projectiles explode at the end of their flight. Projectiles from this skill cannot return. Requires a Sword or Axe. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Splitting Steel of Ammunition
entries.definition: Consume Steel Shards to fire a single projectile that splits on impact or at the targeted location, dealing area damage when it splits and again when the split projectiles explode at the end of their flight. Projectiles from this skill cannot return. Requires a Sword or Axe. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Static Strike
entries.definition: Attack with a melee weapon, gaining static energy for a duration if you hit an enemy. While you have static energy, you'll frequently hit a number of nearby enemies with beams, dealing attack damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Static Strike of Gathering Lightning
entries.definition: Attack with a melee weapon, gaining a Gathering Lightning buff for a duration if you hit an enemy. While you have Gathering Lightning, attacks with this skill will cause chaining beams of lightning, which chain additional times the more Gathering Lightning you have. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Stormbind
entries.definition: Channel to spread runes on the ground in a growing pattern. The runes fade away after a duration, or will be immediately removed and deal damage in a circular area when detonated by Rune Blast. Enemies standing on the runes are Hindered, reducing their movement speed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Stormbind of Teleportation
entries.definition: Channel to spread runes on the ground in a growing pattern. The runes fade away after a duration, or will be immediately removed and deal damage in a circular area when detonated by Rune Blast. Enemies standing on the runes are Hindered, reducing their movement speed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Storm Brand
entries.definition: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, firing beams which deal damage to nearby enemies and those around them. The brand will detach if the enemy dies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Storm Brand of Indecision
entries.definition: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, firing a beam which deals damage to the branded enemy and those around it. The brand will detach if the enemy dies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Storm Burst
entries.definition: Unleash orbs of energy while you channel that repeatedly jump towards the targeted location until their duration expires, dealing damage in a small area after each jump. When you stop channelling, all remaining orbs explode, dealing higher damage in a larger area. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Storm Burst of Repulsion
entries.definition: Unleash orbs of energy while you channel that repeatedly jump away from the targeted location until their duration expires, dealing damage in a small area after each jump. When you stop channelling, all remaining orbs explode, dealing higher damage in a larger area. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Storm Call
entries.definition: Sets a marker at a location. After a short duration, lightning strikes the marker, dealing damage around it and causing lightning strikes at any other markers you've cast. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Storm Call of Trarthus
entries.definition: Sets a marker at a location. After a short duration, a bolt strikes the marker, dealing physical damage around it and causing bolts to strike at any other markers you've cast. Bolt impacts will leave behind a pool of boiling blood, which deals physical damage over time to enemies within it for a secondary duration. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Storm Rain
entries.definition: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location, dealing area damage. The arrow sticks in the ground where it lands, and periodically fires a beam of lightning to another arrow near it, dealing area damage between them. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Storm Rain of the Conduit
entries.definition: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location, dealing area damage. The arrow sticks in the ground where it lands, and periodically fires a beam of lightning to you, dealing area damage between the arrow and you. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Storm Rain of the Fence
entries.definition: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location, dealing area damage. The arrow sticks in the ground where it lands, and periodically fires a beam of lightning to another arrow near it, dealing area damage between them. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Stormblast Mine
entries.definition: Throws a mine that deals damage in an area when detonated. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.
