entries.name: Summon Carrion Golem
entries.definition: Summons a Carrion Golem that grants added physical damage for your non-golem minions. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, as well as a cascade of bone spikes, and deals more damage for each of your non-golem minions near it. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Carrion Golem of Hordes
entries.definition: Summons a Carrion Golem. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, as well as a cascade of bone spikes. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Carrion Golem of Scavenging
entries.definition: Summons a Carrion Golem. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, can consume corpses to heal itself and gain the ability to unleash a devastating cascade of bone spikes, and deals more damage for each of your non-golem minions near it. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Chaos Golem
entries.definition: Summons a Chaos Golem that grants you damage over time and chaos resistance. The Chaos Golem can cast a damage over time Chaos aura and a cascade of Chaos spikes in addition to its melee attack. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Chaos Golem of Hordes
entries.definition: Summons a Chaos Golem. The Chaos Golem can cast a damage over time Chaos aura and a cascade of Chaos spikes in addition to its melee attack. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Chaos Golem of the Maelström
aliases: Summon Chaos Golem of the Maelström
entries.definition: Summons a Chaos Golem. The Chaos Golem can cast a powerful damage over time Chaos aura that Withers enemies in addition to its melee attack. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Flame Golem
entries.definition: Summons a Flame Golem that grants you increased Damage and Area of Effect. The Flame Golem can cast a fire spray, a wave of fire damage, and an explosive arcing projectile. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Flame Golem of Hordes
entries.definition: Summons a Flame Golem. The Flame Golem can cast a fire spray, a wave of fire damage, and an explosive arcing projectile. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Flame Golem of the Meteor
aliases: Summon Flame Golem of the Meteor
entries.definition: Summons a Flame Golem. When summoned, the Flame Golem attacks by falling from the sky, dealing fire damage in an area and leaving burning ground around the impact. After landing, it can cast a fire spray and a wave of fire damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Holy Relic
entries.definition: Summon a Holy Relic that stays near you. When you hit an enemy with an attack, the Holy Relic triggers a nova spell with a short cooldown, that deals physical damage to enemies and grants life regeneration to allies in an area around it. This life regeneration is higher when applied to minions. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Holy Relic of Conviction
entries.definition: Summon a Holy Relic that stays near you. When you hit an enemy with an attack, the Holy Relic triggers a spell with a short cooldown, that deals physical damage to enemies in an area around a nearby enemy. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Ice Golem
entries.definition: Summons an Ice Golem that grants you increased Critical Strike Chance and Accuracy. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning attack in addition to its melee attack. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Ice Golem of Hordes
entries.definition: Summons an Ice Golem. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning attack in addition to its melee attack. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Ice Golem of Shattering
entries.definition: Summons an Ice Golem. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning attack in addition to its melee attack. If reduced to low life it will trigger a spell that destroys itself to deal area damage and fire icy projectiles in a circle. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Lightning Golem
entries.definition: Summons a Lightning Golem that grants you increased attack and cast speed, and mana regeneration. The Lightning Golem fires a projectile spell, creates orbs of Lightning that zap nearby enemies, and casts a temporary aura that grants added Lightning Damage to spells and attacks used by the Golem and its nearby allies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Lightning Golem of Hordes
entries.definition: Summons a Lightning Golem. The Lightning Golem fires a projectile spell, creates orbs of Lightning that zap nearby enemies, and casts a temporary aura that grants added Lightning Damage to spells and attacks used by the Golem and its nearby allies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Raging Spirit
entries.definition: Summons a short-lived flaming skull that rushes at nearby enemies and attacks them rapidly, converting all its physical damage to fire. Enemies will not directly engage these spirits, and can pass through them. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Raging Spirit of Enormity
entries.definition: Summons a short-lived flaming skull that rushes at nearby enemies and attacks them rapidly, converting all its physical damage to fire. Enemies will not directly engage these spirits, and can pass through them. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Reaper
entries.definition: Summons a powerful Reaper which uses a variety of slashing area attacks. The Reaper's presence weakens your other minions, and it will consume them to temporarily empower and heal itself. Using this skill while the Reaper is already summoned causes it to dash to the targeted location and perform a powerful attack. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Reaper of Revenants
entries.definition: Summons a Reaper which uses a variety of slashing area attacks. The presence of any Reapers weakens your other non-Reaper minions, and Reapers will consume them to temporarily empower and heal themselves. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Reaper of Eviscerating
entries.definition: Summons a powerful Reaper which passively follows you without attacking enemies. The Reaper's presence weakens your other minions, and it will consume them to temporarily empower and heal itself. Using this skill while the Reaper is already summoned causes it to dash to the targeted location and perform a powerful attack. Cannot be triggered, supported by Spell Echo or Unleash, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.  This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Skeletons
entries.definition: Summon Skeleton Warrior minions at the targeted location. They use a melee attack and die after a duration. If made aggressive, Skeleton Warriors will also dash towards nearby enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Skeletons of Archers
entries.definition: Summon Skeleton Archer minions at the targeted location. They fire arrows and die after a duration. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Skeletons of Mages
entries.definition: Summon Skeleton Mage minions of random elemental types at the targeted location. They cast projectile spells based on their element, and die after a duration. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Skitterbots
entries.definition: Summon a Chilling Skitterbot and a Shocking Skitterbot, which will trigger your traps and detonate your mines. Mines detonated by Skitterbots will re-arm and can then be detonated again. The Skitterbots grant you more trap and mine damage, and cannot be targeted or damaged. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Stone Golem
entries.definition: Summons a Stone Golem that grants you life regeneration and defences. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Stone Golem of Hordes
entries.definition: Summons a Stone Golem. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Stone Golem of Safeguarding
entries.definition: Summons a Stone Golem that takes a portion of the melee damage you recieve from enemy hits from its life before yours. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Sunder
entries.definition: Slams the ground, creating a slow wave of churning terrain that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies around them. Using the skill again will stop the previous wave. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Staff or Unarmed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Sunder of Earthbreaking
entries.definition: Slams the ground, creating a wave of churning terrain that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies around them. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Staff or Unarmed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Sunder of Trarthus
entries.definition: Slams the ground, creating a slow wave of churning terrain that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies around them. Using the skill again will stop the previous wave. When the wave reaches a target or terrain, it can restart aiming towards an enemy, if one is in range. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Staff or Unarmed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Added Chaos Damage
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Added Cold Damage
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Added Fire Damage
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Added Lightning Damage
entries.definition: Supports any skill that hits enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Additional Accuracy
entries.definition: Supports attack skills. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Advanced Traps
entries.definition: Supports skills which throw traps. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ancestral Call
entries.definition: Supports melee strike skills, causing them to also strike at extra targets simultaneously. The extra targets must be a minimum distance from the user. entries.name: Thunderstorm
entries.definition: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location. On impact, deals area damage and creates a thunderstorm which blinds enemies within it. Entering the thunderstorm will cause it to gain stages, and leaving it will cause it to dissipate. Leaving the storm while it is at maximum stages will cause it to explode, dealing damage and triggering Thunderburst. You must use this skill yourself, it cannot be used by Totems, Traps, Mines, or other objects that use skills for you. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Tornado
entries.definition: Create a Tornado that hinders and repeatedly damages enemies around it. It will move forward for a duration, during which your projectiles can collide with it to deal damage as though it was an enemy. Then it will chase down enemies for a secondary duration, and reflect a portion of the damage it took from your projectiles to them in addition to its own damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Tornado of Elemental Turbulence
entries.definition: Create a Tornado of a random element that hinders and repeatedly damages enemies around it, converting physical damage to its element. The Tornado will chase down enemies for a duration. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Tornado Shot
entries.definition: Fires a piercing shot that travels until it reaches the targeted location. It will then fire projectiles out in all directions from that point, which will travel for a short time before disappearing. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Tornado Shot of Cloudburst
entries.definition: Fires a single payload arrow into the air to land at a targeted location. It will then fire arrows out in all directions from that point. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Toxic Rain
entries.definition: Fire arrows into the air that rain down around the targeted area, dealing damage to enemies they hit and creating spore pods where they land. Each spore pod deals chaos damage over time to nearby enemies and slows their movement speed. The pods last for a duration before bursting, dealing area damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Toxic Rain of Sporeburst
entries.definition: Fire arrows into the air that rain down around the targeted area, dealing damage to enemies they hit and creating spore pods where they land. Each spore pod slows the movement speed of nearby enemies. The pods last for a duration before bursting, dealing area damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Toxic Rain of Withering
entries.definition: Fire arrows into the air that rain down around the targeted area, dealing damage to enemies they hit and creating spore pods where they land. Each spore pod deals chaos damage over time to nearby enemies and withers them, causing them to take increased chaos damage. The pods last for a duration before bursting, dealing area damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Unearth
entries.definition: Fires a projectile that will pierce through enemies to impact the ground at the targeted location, creating a Bone Archer corpse where it lands. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Absolution
entries.definition: Causes one of your existing Sentinels of Absolution to Ascend, becoming more powerful, gaining new spells, and overriding its duration, while maintaining its other bonuses, including from support gems. If you cannot have more Ascended Sentinels of Absolution, an existing one will be refreshed instead. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Animate Weapon
entries.definition: Animates multiple Melee Weapon Items and Lingering Blades to fight by your side, and transforms them into different, unique weapons. You cannot animate unidentified Weapons. Will not animate weapons with 6 sockets. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Arc
entries.definition: A shocking arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies. Each time the arc chains from an enemy, it will do so simultaneously to two further enemies, but never to enemies that have already been hit by any of these chains. Also grants a buff making your Arc damage lucky for a short duration. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Arctic Armour
entries.definition: Immediately encases you in ice, protecting you for a duration or until you take damage from a number of hits, and also grants a buff once the cast time has finished. You cannot move or perform non-instant actions while in the ice. When the ice breaks, the buff is also removed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Blade Flurry
entries.definition: Channel to create an expanding circle area around you that blinds enemies within it. When you stop channelling, deals damage in a smaller area around each enemy in the circle. Requires a Dagger, Claw or One-Handed Sword. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Blade Vortex
entries.definition: Creates an independently-moving vortex of ethereal blades which lasts for a duration. The vortex moves toward nearby enemies, repeatedly damaging enemies that it passes through. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Blight
entries.definition: Apply a powerful debuff to enemies around you which deals chaos damage over time. Then applies two additional layers in a larger area, growing greatly in size each time. Enemies are also substantially hindered for a shorter secondary duration, slowing their movement. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Burning Arrow
entries.definition: Fires an arrow that explodes, dealing fire damage to its target and other nearby enemies, with an increased chance of igniting them. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Caustic Arrow
entries.definition: Fires a slow-moving serpentine arrow which deals chaos damage while piercing enemies, and leaves a trail of caustic ground. Enemies standing on the caustic ground take chaos damage over time. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Clarity
entries.definition: Casts a temporary aura that lets you and your allies cast skills without paying their mana costs. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Cleave
entries.definition: The character swings their weapon (or both weapons if dual wielding) in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Killing Blows on Rare or Unique enemies grant a buff that improves Cleave for a duration. Killing Blows on Rare Enemies also steal their modifiers for a secondary duration. Only works with Axes and Swords. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Cold Snap
entries.definition: Creates a sudden burst of cold around you, damaging enemies. This also creates a chilling area around you which expands and deals cold damage over time to surrounding enemies in addition to chilling them. Enemies that die while in the area grant Frenzy Charges, and you will passively gain Frenzy Charges while there are enemies in the area. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Cyclone
entries.definition: Spin and attack in place, damaging nearby enemies and pulling others towards you. While using this skill, you cannot be stunned or knocked back. Cannot be supported by Ruthless. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Detonate Dead
entries.definition: Targets a corpse, and deals spell damage to enemies around the corpse, as well as causing the corpse to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected. This will continue to target other corpses in the area, with an increasing delay between each one, until it runs out of corpses or has destroyed 22 corpses. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Discipline
entries.definition: Casts a temporary aura that prevents energy shield recharge being delayed by damage taken for you and your allies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Domination
entries.definition: This spell causes one of your existing Sentinels of Dominance to Ascend, becoming more powerful, gaining new attacks, and overriding its duration, while maintaining its monster modifiers and other bonuses, including from support gems. If you cannot have more Ascended Sentinels of Dominance, an existing one will be refreshed instead. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Double Strike
entries.definition: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon, each of which summons a double of you for a duration to continuously attack monsters in this fashion. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Earthquake
entries.definition: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a short duration. After using this skill, your steps will deal damage around you, cracking the earth if the previous cracks have erupted. This effect ends after a secondary duration, or after a maximum number of aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Fireball
entries.definition: Launches a series of fireballs in a spiral around the caster. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Firestorm
entries.definition: A fixed number of flaming bolts rain down in a spiral, culminating in the central one impacting the targeted location. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies and leaving burning ground, which deals fire damage over time. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Flameblast
entries.definition: Targets an area and builds up stages in that area based on cast speed. It explodes every 3 stages, until it reaches a maximum of 15. As it gains more stages, the area gets smaller but the damage gets higher. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Flicker Strike
entries.definition: Repeatedly teleports to enemies and hits them, inflicting a wound but dealing no damage. After the repeating finishes, each enemy is hit by the total damage of their wounds, which are removed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Glacial Hammer
entries.definition: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to cold damage. It traps enemies with you in a circle of ice so that they can't escape. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Grace
entries.definition: Casts a temporary aura that grants you and your allies additional chance to evade attacks, and makes suppressed spell damage unlucky against you. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Ground Slam
entries.definition: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wave that travels in all directions that damages enemies with an increased chance to stun. The wave deals more damage to closer enemies. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Haste
entries.definition: Casts a temporary aura that increases the movement speed, attack speed and cast speed of you and your allies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Ice Nova
entries.definition: A chilling circle of ice expands from the caster, repeating from every enemy it hits. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Ice Shot
entries.definition: Fires an arrow that converts some physical damage to cold on its target and converts all physical damage to cold in a cone behind that target. When you use this skill, it summons a squad of Mirage Sharpshooters for a duration. Cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Immortal Call
entries.definition: Discharges Endurance Charges, making the character unable to die or gain Vaal souls for a short time, proportional to how many endurance charges were expended. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Impurity of Fire
entries.definition: Casts an aura that reduces fire damage taken and provides ignite immunity to you and nearby allies, and makes hits against nearby enemies ignore their fire resistance.  This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Impurity of Ice
entries.definition: Casts an aura that reduces cold damage taken and provides freeze and chill immunity to you and nearby allies, and makes hits against nearby enemies ignore their cold resistance.  This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Impurity of Lightning
entries.definition: Casts an aura that reduces lightning damage taken and provides shock immunity to you and nearby allies, and makes hits against nearby enemies ignore their lightning resistance.  This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Lightning Arrow
entries.definition: Fires charged arrows, which repeatedly travel for a short time before changing direction. When they hit enemies, they are struck by a bolt of lightning which damages a number of surrounding enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Lightning Strike
entries.definition: Infuses your melee weapon with electrical energies as you swing. In addition to converting some of your physical damage to lightning damage, the stored energy becomes an orb attached to the enemy you hit, or the ground if you don't hit an enemy. The orb will periodically fire projectiles at other nearby enemies for a duration, which will also damage the enemy the orb is attached to. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Lightning Trap
entries.definition: Throws a trap that launches a ring of projectiles through the enemy that set it off, dealing lightning damage to them and subsequent targets and leaving a trail of shocked ground. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Lightning Warp
entries.definition: Casts a delayed teleport for nearby enemies to a target destination. When the teleport occurs, lightning damage is dealt to the enemies both before and after they teleport. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Molten Shell
entries.definition: Applies a buff that raises your armour, and takes some of the damage from hits for you before being depleted. Each second, the skill deals reflected damage to surrounding enemies based on the damage taken by the buff in that second. When the buff is removed, the skill deals reflected damage to enemies around you based on the total damage that was taken by the buff. You cannot have the buff at the same time as any other Guard skill. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Molten Strike
entries.definition: Infuses your melee weapon with molten energies to attack with physical and fire damage. This attack causes balls of molten magma to launch forth causing area attack damage to enemies where they land. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Breach
entries.definition: This skill is temporarily disabled and cannot be used. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Power Siphon
entries.definition: Fires your wand simultaneously at all nearby enemies, culling those close to death and granting you a power charge for each. Cannot be supported by Volley. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Rain of Arrows
entries.definition: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to land in multiple sequences after a delay, each starting at the targeted location and spreading outwards in all directions. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it. Half of the arrows will land directly on targets if there are targets in their range. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Reap
entries.definition: Bloody scythes swipe around a selected area, hitting enemies with physical damage. An area of boiling blood is left beneath them for a duration which deals physical damage over time. Also gives a bonus to maximum Blood Charges for a secondary duration. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Reave
entries.definition: Repeatedly attacks a large area in different directions. Each Vaal Reave that hits an enemy grants stages, which you will begin to lose after a short period without hitting anything. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Rejuvenation Totem
entries.definition: Summons a totem that has an aura which regenerates life for you and your nearby allies. When things affected by the aura are hit, the totem's life is removed instead for some of the damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Righteous Fire
entries.definition: Sacrifices a portion of your Life and Energy Shield to engulf you in magical fire that rapidly burns nearby enemies for a duration. Your spell damage is increased while under this effect. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Smite
entries.definition: Calls lightning down to infuse your weapon, then performs a melee attack and causes lightning to strike nearby enemies, dealing damage in an area. Hitting an enemy grants an aura for a duration. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Spark
entries.definition: Continuously launches unpredictable sparks in all directions that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Spectral Throw
entries.definition: Throws several spectral copies of your melee weapon. They fly out and then return to you, in a spinning attack that damages enemies in their path. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Storm Call
entries.definition: Sets a marker at a location. Lightning strikes random enemies around the marker repeatedly over the skill's duration, dealing damage in an area around the strike. Modifiers to the skill's duration will also affect the delay between these strikes. When the duration ends, a large bolt of lightning strikes the marker, dealing damage around it. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Summon Skeletons
entries.definition: Summons an army of skeletal soldiers, archers and mages, led by a powerful general. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Venom Gyre
entries.definition: Creates already-caught projectiles without firing them first, both immediately and over a secondary duration. Caught projectiles spiral outwards when you use Whirling Blades and do not return. Requires a Dagger or Claw. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vaal Volcanic Fissure
entries.definition: Slam the ground, creating a winding fissure that deals area damage while travelling outwards. When it reaches the target location it erupts, releasing a burst of molten projectiles. After erupting, the fissure continues moving towards enemies to cause further eruptions. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vampiric Link
entries.definition: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they get recovery from your life leech instead of you. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vengeful Cry
entries.definition: Retaliate against a savage hit with a warcry, taunting all nearby enemies to attack the user. The user and nearby allies gain a buff which grants rage and prevents rage from being lost. Minions cannot gain rage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Venom Gyre
entries.definition: Fires a returning projectile that can be caught. Caught projectiles spiral outwards when you use Whirling Blades and do not return. Requires a Dagger or Claw. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vigilant Strike
entries.definition: Attacks enemies with a powerful melee strike which grants Fortification, reducing damage you take from hits. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge. Requires a Melee Weapon. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Viper Strike
entries.definition: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to chaos damage and inflicting poison which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. If dual wielding, will strike with both weapons. Requires a claw, dagger or sword. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Viper Strike of the Mamba
entries.definition: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to chaos damage and inflicting poison which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. If dual wielding, deals the damage of both weapons in one strike. Requires a claw, dagger or sword. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vitality
entries.definition: Casts an aura that grants life regeneration to you and your allies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Void Sphere
entries.definition: Creates a Void Sphere which Hinders enemies in an area around it, with the debuff being stronger on enemies closer to the sphere. It also regularly releases pulses of area damage. The Void Sphere will consume the corpses of any enemies which die in its area. Can only have one Void Sphere at a time. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Void Sphere of Rending
entries.definition: Creates a Void Sphere which Hinders enemies in an area around it, with the debuff being stronger on enemies closer to the sphere. It also regularly releases pulses of area damage. The Void Sphere will consume the corpses of any enemies which die in its area. Can only have one Void Sphere at a time. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Volatile Dead
entries.definition: Corpses near the targeted location explode, dealing damage in a small area and creating an orb which moves towards nearby enemies before dealing spell damage in a larger area. The explosion of the corpse is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Volatile Dead of Confinement
entries.definition: Corpses near the targeted location explode, dealing damage in a small area and creating an orb which detonates after a duration, dealing spell damage in a larger area. The explosion of the corpse is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Volatile Dead of Seething
entries.definition: Corpses near the targeted location explode, dealing damage in a small area and creating an orb which moves towards nearby enemies before dealing spell damage in a larger area. The explosion of the corpse is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Volcanic Fissure
entries.definition: Slam the ground, creating a winding fissure that deals area damage while travelling outwards. When it reaches the target location it erupts, releasing a burst of molten projectiles. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Volcanic Fissure of Snaking
entries.definition: Slam the ground, creating a winding fissure that deals area damage while travelling outwards. When it reaches the target location it erupts dealing damage in an area. After erupting, the fissure continues moving towards enemies to cause further eruptions. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Voltaxic Burst
entries.definition: Each cast of this spell waits for a short duration, releasing a burst of lightning and chaos spell damage in an area around you when that duration ends. Enemies killed by this damage, or shortly after, will explode. The explosions of the corpses are not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vortex
entries.definition: An icy blast explodes around the caster, dealing cold damage to enemies, and leaving behind a whirling vortex which deals cold damage over time and chills enemies caught in it. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vortex of Projection
entries.definition: An icy blast explodes around the caster, dealing cold damage to enemies, and leaving behind a whirling vortex which deals cold damage over time and chills enemies caught in it. If the caster targets near their Frostbolt projectiles, it will explode from a number of those projectiles instead, destroying them. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Vulnerability
entries.definition: Curse all targets in an area, causing them to take increased physical damage. Attacks against the cursed enemies have a chance to inflict bleeding. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Wall of Force
entries.definition: Creates a wall of force which allies and enemies can pass through, but allied projectiles which can collide with enemies will also collide with this wall, and can chain from it to other targets. Projectiles can only collide with a single Wall of Force, and no more than once. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: War Banner
entries.definition: You must gain Valour from melee combat to use this skill, which will consume all Valour to place a banner with an aura. The aura will be larger and more powerful the more Valour was consumed. The banner lasts for a duration, but will end early if you leave the aura, or use the skill again while it's active. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Warlord's Mark
entries.definition: Curses a single enemy, giving a chance to double the duration of stuns on them. Attacking the cursed enemy will leech life and mana, stunning them will grant rage, and killing it will grant an endurance charge. You can only have one Mark at a time. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Wave of Conviction
entries.definition: An expanding wave of energy surges forward, damaging enemies in a cone-shaped area over a duration. Each enemy hit is inflicted with Exposure matching the element of which they took the highest damage. Only one Wave of Conviction can be active at a time This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Wave of Conviction of Trarthus
entries.definition: An expanding wave of energy surges outwards from you, damaging enemies in a ring-shaped area over a duration. The ring then returns, damaging enemies again on the way back. Only one Wave of Conviction can be active at a time This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Whirling Blades
entries.definition: Dive through enemies, dealing weapon damage. If dual wielding attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one hit. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Wild Strike
entries.definition: Your melee weapon strikes enemies, converting physical damage to a random element. Then, depending on the element chosen, it releases a fiery explosion, an arcing bolt of lightning, or an icy wave. It will avoid choosing the same element twice in a row. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Wild Strike of Extremes
entries.definition: Your melee weapon strikes enemies, converting physical damage to a random element. Then, depending on the element chosen, it releases a fiery explosion, an arcing bolt of lightning, or an icy wave. It will avoid choosing the same element twice in a row. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Winter Orb
entries.definition: Channel to conjure an orb above you, which pelts nearby enemies with projectiles that impact the ground and explode. Channelling for longer builds up stages on the skill. When you stop channelling, the stages decay over a duration. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Wintertide Brand
entries.definition: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy, dealing cold damage over time and chilling them. It periodically activates while attached, gaining stages that raise the damage. When removed, a short-duration debuff dealing the same damage over time and chill is applied to each nearby enemy. The brand keeps its charges while detached. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Wither
entries.definition: Casts a debilitating debuff on enemies in an area, hindering their movement and also inflicts the Withered debuff, which increases the Chaos Damage they take and can stack up to 15 times. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Withering Step
entries.definition: Grants Elusive and a buff that grants Phasing. While you have this buff, monsters that enter an area around you will be Withered. Using a skill or losing the Elusive buff ends this skill's effects. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills. Cannot be used while already Elusive. entries.name: Aspect of Solaris

entries.name: Aspect of the Avian
