The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking physical damage from hits, or if depleted. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Primal Aegis
entries.definition: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes elemental damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking elemental damage from hits, or if depleted. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Queen's Demand
entries.definition: Alternates triggering Flames of Judgement and Storm of Judgement This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Raise Spiders
entries.definition: Raise two spectral spiders from each nearby corpse that will attack your enemies with Viper Strike. Each raised spider grants you increased Attack Speed and increased Damage with Poison. Enemies will not engage the spiders directly, and they are immune to damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ravenous
entries.definition: Consumes a targeted corpse, granting you a buff that gives you bonuses against enemies of the same monster category as the corpse. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Abberath's Fury
entries.definition: While you run, this skill creates a small explosion with each step, dealing fire damage in an area around you. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Cinders
entries.definition: While active, your bow attacks inflict Cinderflame. Cinderflame deals fire damage over time, and can stack up to ten times. This skill cannot be cast by Totems. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Shade Form
entries.definition: Makes you immune to physical damage, and harder for enemies to detect, for a duration. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Shaper's Ire
entries.definition: Shaper's Memory casts this spell for you to fire a damaging beam for a duration that deals damage over time to things in it. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Shaper's Despair
entries.definition: Shaper's Memory casts this spell for you to fire piercing projectiles in front of you that deal cold damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Shaper's Devastation
entries.definition: Shaper's Memory uses this attack for you to teleport to an enemy and attack with a powerful blow, dealing area damage based on your weapon. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Shield Shatter
entries.definition: Your shield shatters, dealing physical spell damage to enemies in an area, based on the shield's quality. For a short duration after this, you will be unable to block and will gain no defences from your shield, but your spells will deal added physical damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Blazing Glare
entries.definition: When hit, release a nova of fiery vengeance, dealing spell fire damage and blinding enemies struck. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Spectral Spirits
entries.definition: Summons three invulnerable spectral skulls that rush at nearby enemies and attack them rapidly. Enemies will not engage these spirits, and can pass through them. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Spirit Burst
entries.definition: Consumes a spirit charge to fire projectiles which deals physical damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Stalking Pustule
entries.definition: A corpse near the targeted location explodes, dealing damage in a small area and creating an orb which moves towards nearby enemies before dealing spell damage in a larger area. The explosion of the corpse is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Storm Cascade
entries.definition: Lightning crackles in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Bone Feeders
entries.definition: Summon two Bone Feeders which follow you around. Bone Feeders consume corpses they walk over, creating a temporary Aura after consuming 10 corpses. One Bone Feeder creates a Curse Aura of either Temporal Chains, Enfeeble or Punishment that ignores Curse Limits. The other Bone Feeder creates an Aura that causes Enemy Damage with Hits to be Unlucky. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Arbalists
entries.definition: Summons Arbalist minions which use projectile attacks. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Bestial Rhoa
entries.definition: Summons a Bestial Rhoa. In addition to its melee attack, the Bestial Rhoa uses a charge and has an aura that intimidates enemies. Enemies will not engage this minion directly, and they are immune to damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Bestial Snake
entries.definition: Summons a Bestial Snake. The Bestial Snake fires powerful chaos projectile attacks. Enemies will not engage this minion directly, and they are immune to damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Bestial Ursa
entries.definition: Summons a Bestial Ursa. In addition to its melee attack, the Bestial Ursa uses a powerful Ground Slam and Rallying Cry. Enemies will not engage this minion directly, and they are immune to damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Doedre's Effigy
entries.definition: Summons an effigy of Doedre, which will project auras of all the curse skill gems socketed in Doedre's Skin. These curses have less effectiveness. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Elemental Relic
entries.definition: Summons a Relic of a random element that stays near you. Depending on the element chosen, the relic minion will have an Anger, Hatred, or Wrath aura. These relics explode when they die, dealing elemental damage to enemies around them. If you already have a relic of the chosen element, its duration will be refreshed instead of summoning a new one. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Harbinger of Brutality
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. When you are near a rare or unique enemy, the minion will occasionally grant you a buff giving significantly increased Damage, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed, and reducing the Damage you take. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Greater Harbinger of Brutality
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. When you are near a rare or unique enemy, the minion will occasionally grant you a buff giving significantly increased Damage, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed, reducing the Damage you take, and causing Bleeding Enemies that you Kill to Explode, dealing 10% of their maximum Life as Physical Damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Harbinger of Directions
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will cast a random buff on you that grants one or all of the following: 1 additional Projectile, +1 Chain, Pierce 1 additional Target, or Projectiles Fork. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Greater Harbinger of Directions
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will cast a random buff on you that grants one or all of the following: Fire 2 additional Projectiles, Chain 2 additional times, Projectiles Pierce 2 additional targets, or Projectiles Fork then Fork an additional time. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Harbinger of Focus
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. While you are channelling, the minion will occasionally cast a buff on you that reduces the Damage you take, and makes you avoid all Stuns and Elemental Ailments. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Visiting Harbinger of Focus
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. While you are channelling, the minion will occasionally cast a buff on you that reduces the Damage you take, makes you avoid all Stuns and Elemental Ailments, and prevents Curses affecting you. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Greater Harbinger of Focus
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. While you are channelling, the minion will occasionally cast a buff on you that reduces the Damage you take, makes you avoid all Stuns and Elemental Ailments, and prevents Curses affecting you. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Harbinger of Storms
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally apply a Chill or Shock to an enemy that chains to other nearby enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Greater Harbinger of Storms
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally apply a Chill or Shock with increased effect to an enemy that chains to other nearby enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Harbinger of the Arcane
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally cast Arcane Surge on you, granting increased Cast Speed and Mana Regeneration. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Visiting Harbinger of the Arcane
aliases: Summon Visiting Harbinger of the Arcane
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion has two buff spells it will cast on you: Arcane Surge, granting increased Cast Speed and Mana Regeneration, and a buff that grants Chance to Shock and Lightning Penetration. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Greater Harbinger of the Arcane
aliases: Summon Greater Harbinger of the Arcane
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion has two buff spells it will cast on you: Arcane Surge, granting increased Cast Speed and Mana Regeneration, and a buff that grants Chance to Shock and Lightning Penetration. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Harbinger of Time
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally create an aura on you that increases the Action Speed of you, and all allies and enemies near you. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Visiting Harbinger of Time
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally create an aura on you that increases the Action Speed of you and all allies near you. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Greater Harbinger of Time
entries.definition: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally create an aura on you that increases the Action Speed of you and all allies near you. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Tawhoa's Chosen
entries.definition: This skill is triggered when you use a Slam or Strike skill, and summons a Mirage Chieftain who will use that Slam or Strike skill once before dissipating. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Sentinel of Radiance
entries.definition: Summons a Sentinel of Radiance which follows you and attacks enemies in melee, while burning enemies around it and taking a portion of damage from hits for you. You can only have one Sentinel of Radiance. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Shaper Memory
entries.definition: Consume Remembrance to summon a memory of the Shaper, which will use a skill once before fading away. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Spectral Tiger
entries.definition: Summons a Spectral Tiger Companion that attacks nearby enemies and dies after a duration. Each Spectral Tiger grants you a buff that increases Critical Strike Chance, and increases Attack and Cast Speed. If you have the maximum number of them, refreshes the duration and life of an existing one instead. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Spectral Wolf
entries.definition: Summons a spectral wolf companion that attacks nearby enemies and dies after a duration. Each spectral wolf grants you a buff that adds damage to your attacks. If you have the maximum number of them, refreshes the duration and life of an existing one instead. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Taunting Contraption
entries.definition: Summons a Taunting Contraption that taunts nearby enemies to attack it. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Void Spawn
entries.definition: Summon a Void Spawn minion, which casts a lightning projectile spell with a chance to shock enemies. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Tentacle Whip
entries.definition: This attack causes three otherworldly tentacles to strike the ground around you, each dealing your attack damage in an area. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Thirst for Blood
entries.definition: Reserves some of your life to cause bleeding you inflict to be stronger, and grant life regeneration based on the number bleeding enemies nearby. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Spirit of Ahuana
entries.definition: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Ramako tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which prevents additional damage from suppressed spells. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Spirit of Akoya
entries.definition: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Tukohama tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which regenerates rage. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Spirit of Ikiaho
entries.definition: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Arohongui tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which makes travel skills recover cooldowns faster. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Spirit of Kahuturoa
entries.definition: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Rongokurai tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which lets a percentage of your armour protect against all damage types. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Spirit of Kaom
entries.definition: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Ngamahu tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which allows totems to take some damage from hits for you. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Spirit of Kiloava
entries.definition: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Valako tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which recovers life, mana and energy shield when you block. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Spirit of Maata
entries.definition: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Tawhoa tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which refills flasks. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Spirit of Rakiata
entries.definition: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Tasalio tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which prevents your action speed being lowered. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Spirit of Tawhanuku
entries.definition: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Hinekora tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which regenerates mana. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Spirit of Utula
entries.definition: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Kitava tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which makes a percentage of your leech recover instantly. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Fleshrend
entries.definition: Fires a projectile that turns towards enemies in front of it. The projectile does not hit enemies, but as it travels it applies a short physical damage over time debuff to each enemy in an area around it, stacking up to 3 times. The debuff also increases the damage over time they take from all sources. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Consecrate
entries.definition: Creates an area of Consecrated Ground, providing life regeneration and reducing the effect of curses for you and allies who stand in it. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Heaven's Scourge
entries.definition: A bolt of Beidat's lightning strikes an area, dealing lightning damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Molten Burst
entries.definition: Launch molten projectiles from the point of impact, causing AoE attack damage to enemies where they land. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Shock Ground
entries.definition: Creates a patch of Shocked Ground in a radius around you. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Starfall
entries.definition:
Stars fall, raining destruction down over an area. Falling stars deal Attack Damage.
Cannot be Supported by Trigger Support Gems. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Triggered Summon Phantasm
entries.definition: Summons a Phantasm minion, which uses a piercing projectile spell that deals physical damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Create Lesser Shrine
entries.definition: Creates a Lesser Shrine, which will grant a bonus when touched. The Lesser Shrine will disappear after a short duration, or when used. This skill starts on cooldown. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Twister
entries.definition: Launches an unpredictable, piercing twister projectile that moves randomly for a duration, repeatedly dealing damage to enemies it intersects. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Unhinge
entries.definition: Relinquish your grip on reality. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Reflection
entries.definition: When you attack with The Saviour and deal a critical strike, this skill can summon a Mirage Saviour. Summoned Mirage Saviours will fight for you using whichever of your attack skills you dealt the critical strike with that caused them to be summoned. Mirage Saviours will not be resummoned using the same skills if you already have the maximum number of them. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Unseen Strike
entries.definition: Launches a spinning blade that deals weapon damage to enemies. If firing multiple projectiles, they will be fired in a circle. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Void Gaze
entries.definition: Applies a debuff to Enemies, removing some of their resistance to Chaos damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Void Shot
entries.definition: Fires an arrow which decelerates to the target location, the arrow will then become unstable and explode dealing weapon damage in an area, converting half of the physical damage to cold damage. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Summon Volatile Anomaly
entries.definition: Creates an orb which moves towards nearby enemies, exploding after a duration or when it gets close enough. The explosion deals cold spell damage in an area, and leaves behind a Vortex on the ground for a secondary duration which continues to deal cold damage over time and chill enemies caught in it. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Ward Shatter
entries.definition: Your ward shatters, dealing physical spell damage to enemies in an area, based on the amount of ward you have. Enemies hit are inflicted with Enervation, a Debuff that lowers Movement Speed by 20% and prevents Life and Energy Shield Recovery for 4 seconds. This is the base skill description; an item’s granted level and special modifiers can change its values.

entries.name: Low life
entries.definition: s.]] Low life is a condition that applies when life is at 50% or lower. Linking mana-reserving skills (such as auras) to which converts them into Life-reserving skills is one of the easiest way to maintain the low life condition.

entries.name: Mana
entries.definition: Mana is a resource most commonly used to pay for skill costs. For the player it is shown as a blue orb in the lower right of the screen.

entries.name: Mark
entries.definition: Marks are a type of curse. Unlike Hexes, only one type of Mark can be applied at a time, and only to a single target.

entries.name: Mind Over Matter
entries.definition: Mind Over Matter (often referred to as MoM) is a keystone passive skill that allows the character's mana to absorb a portion of the damage dealt to life. It is the primary source of the Mana before Life mechanic for increasing effective health.

entries.name: Mine
entries.definition: A mine (or remote mine) is a type of proxy. Mine skills throw a device that uses that skill when detonated. Placed mines reserve mana while placed and most mines create an aura that affects nearby enemies.

entries.name: Minion
entries.definition: Minions are allied monsters summoned by the character. Minions have their own stats, and their actions are treated entirely separately from the summoner.

entries.name: Mirrored
entries.definition: Mirrored is a special property that appear on items created by a or a on a piece of equipment.

entries.name: Offering
entries.definition: Offerings are skills that consume corpses to buff the player's minions. Additional nearby corpses will also be consumed to extend the effect's duration.

entries.name: Oil
entries.definition: An oil is a currency item that can be acquired from Blight encounters. Using them on certain items gives these items an anointment, which can modify them in various ways.

entries.name: Transfigured skill gem
entries.definition: Transfigured skill gems are alternate versions of existing skill gems, denoted by having "" as a suffix that alters its function and balance. While they are technically the same item as their default versions, they can often drastically change the identity of the skill, even changing its gem tags and mechanics.

entries.name: Pain Attunement
entries.definition: Pain Attunement is a keystone passive skill that grants more spell damage when the character is on low life.

entries.name: Passive skill
entries.definition: ]] The passive skill tree is a large network of passive skills, or nodes, that provide stats that affect the player's character (or their minions). All classes use the same tree, but start in different places. When a character levels up or completes certain quests, they gain one passive skill point, which allows the player to allocate a node on the skill tree that is connected to another allocated node.

entries.name: Petrified
entries.definition: Petrify (or Petrified) is a debuff. Similarly to being frozen, petrified modifies the player's action speed by reducing it by 100%. Effects that prevent or minimize lowering of action speed, like Trickster's , Juggernaut's , , , or some Scourge modifiers, will prevent the player from being stuck in place and unable to use any skills. Petrified can only be removed by waiting out its debuff duration.

entries.name: Phasing
entries.definition: Phasing is a boolean stat. Phasing entities can move through enemies, but still obstruct the movement of enemies without phasing.

entries.name: Poison
entries.definition: Poison is an ailment that deals chaos damage over time to the affected target.

entries.name: Power charge
entries.definition: Power charges are one of the three basic charge types. They are associated with intelligence and represent an increase to concentration and arcane energies during combat. They are visualized as glowing blue orbs surrounding the character. Gaining a new power charge resets the duration of all remaining power charges.

entries.name: Attack
entries.definition: Attacks are one of the main categories of skills, the other being spells. All attacks do damage, and some attack skills will also apply buffs or debuffs, or have other effects. The player's default attack is an attack skill that is always available to use.

entries.name: Projectile
entries.definition: Projectiles are entities that travel independently of their creator until they collide with an enemy or obstacle, or reach their travel distance limit of 15 metres. Skill gems that create projectiles usually have the Projectile or Bow gem tag.

entries.name: Quality
entries.definition: Quality improves the signature stat of an item such as the physical damage on weapons and base defence rating on armours or adds additional bonuses to gems.

entries.name: Rampage
entries.definition: Rampage is a kill streak mechanic that provides rewards for killing increasing numbers of enemies without stopping. The rampage effect is only available for characters equipping certain items.

entries.name: Recoup
entries.definition: Recoup is a keyword mechanic that recovers an amount of life, mana, or energy shield over time, based on the damage taken from a hit.

entries.name: Recovery
entries.definition: Recovery refers to all positive changes to the current values of resources, most commonly life, mana, or energy shield. It is a catch-all term, not limited to specific mechanics. The opposite of recovery is loss.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries.definition: Regeneration is a form of recovery that automatically restores life, mana or energy shield over time.

entries.name: Resistance
entries.definition: Resistance modifies the amount of damage taken from elemental (fire, cold, or lightning) or chaos damage. It can be changed with equipment, passives, buffs/debuffs, and other modifiers.

entries.name: Resistance penetration
entries.definition: Resistance penetration is a stat for hit damage that lowers the target's effective resistance to specific damage types for the purpose of damage calculations. The target's actual resistance value itself is untouched.

entries.name: Resolute Technique
entries.definition: Resolute Technique (often referred to as RT) is a keystone passive skill that will raise your chance to hit to 100%, ignoring all accuracy and evasion stats of the attacker and defender respectively, at the cost of preventing you from dealing critical strikes.

entries.name: Return
entries.definition: Return is a behaviour of projectiles that causes them to attempt to return to the entity that fired them after they collide with a target, terrain, or when they reach their maximum travel distance.

entries.name: Aura
entries.definition: An aura is a skill or buff that applies one or more effects on nearby allies and/or enemies within the aura's area of effect. This mechanic can be found on a variety of skills as well as NPCs and enemies.

entries.name: Sapped
entries.definition: Sapped is an Elemental Ailment associated with lightning that causes the affected targets to deal up to 20% less damage, based on the amount of Lightning Damage in the hit, for 4 seconds.

entries.name: Scorch
entries.definition: Scorch is an Elemental Ailment associated with fire that causes the affected target to have their Elemental Resistances lowered by up to 30%, based on the Fire Damage of the Hit, for 4 seconds.

entries.name: Secrets of Suffering
entries.definition: Secrets of Suffering is an item exclusive keystone passive skill. Upon taking it, the character will be unable to directly Ignite, Chill, Freeze or Shock enemies, but will inflict Scorch, Brittle, and Sapped upon a critical strike.

entries.name: Avatar of Fire
entries.definition: Avatar of Fire is a keystone passive skill that converts 50% of physical damage, lightning damage and cold damage to fire damage. However, the character cannot deal damage with any damage types except fire.

entries.name: Avoidance
entries.definition: Avoidance is a keyword used to describe several different chance-based forms of mitigation against hits, certain types of damage, or debuffs or other mechanics.

entries.name: Shock
entries.definition: Shock is an elemental ailment associated with lightning that causes the affected target to take increased damage from all sources. __TOC__

entries.name: Shocked ground
entries.definition: Shocked ground is a detrimental ground effect that inflicts a debuff that causing affected targets to take increased damage from all sources. Unless otherwise specified, it has a base Shock value of 15%.

entries.name: Soul Eater
entries.definition: equipped to steal the Soul Eater buff displaying how stacks increase character size.]]

entries.name: Spell
entries.definition: Spells are skills that are cast or triggered by the user which can deal damage to an enemy or apply positive or negative effects to the caster, allies, or enemies. It is one of the two major categories for skills, the other being attacks. Unlike attacks, spells are not affected by accuracy or evasion.

entries.name: Split (item property)
entries.definition: Splitting items refers to the use of the Fenumal Plagued Arachnid beast, , or corpse modifier in the Necropolis to create a split copy of an item. This adds the split property to both copies, preventing them from being split again.

entries.name: Strength
entries.definition: The strength attribute is a measure of a character's physical power. Strength is required to use strength-based equipment and skills.

entries.name: Strength of Blood
entries.definition: Strength of Blood is a keystone passive skill which disables recovery from non-instant Life Leech, while granting 2% additional physical damage reduction for every 3% recovery per second from life leech.

entries.name: Support gem
entries.definition: A support gem, or support, is a type of gem used to modify the stats and behaviours of compatible skill gems that it is linked to.

entries.name: Supreme Decadence
entries.definition: Supreme Decadence is a keystone passive skill which causes life recovery from flasks to also apply to energy shield, but reduces the recovery amount. Life flask effects are still removed on full life. The amount recovered is based on the life recovery, regardless of your maximum Energy Shield value.

entries.name: Supreme Ego
entries.definition: Supreme Ego is a keystone passive skill which increases your mana reservation amount, and prevents your auras from affecting allies, but grants increased aura effect to a skill per percent of mana reserved by that skill.

entries.name: Supreme Ostentation
entries.definition: Supreme Ostentation is a only keystone passive skill which allows the player to ignore Attribute Requirements (on the gems and equipment) and removes inherent bonuses provided by those attributes, thus making them irrelevant in most cases.

entries.name: Synthesised item
entries.definition: Synthesised items have their base implicit modifiers replaced with up to three Synthesis implicit modifiers. These are potentially very powerful modifiers that can't be obtained otherwise.

entries.name: Tailwind
entries.definition: Tailwind is a buff that grants the user 8% increased action speed for 4 seconds.

entries.name: Taunt
entries.definition: s]] Taunt is a debuff that makes an affected enemy unable to consider any object as a potential target, except the source of the debuff. It also causes enemies to deal 10% less damage to other entities. It lasts for 3 seconds. Taunt can be applied by players, minions, monsters, or proxies that are targetable (e.g. totems, but not traps, mines, or mirages). Taunt immediately expires when the character (or proxy) that applied it dies or expires.

entries.name: Banner
entries.definition: Banner skills are a sub-class of skills that can be manually activated to consume all Valour and place down a banner that provides an aura. The effect and radius of the Banner aura scales with the amount of Valour consumed. Valour is typically gained from melee combat.

entries.name: The Agnostic
entries.definition: The Agnostic is a keystone passive skill that removes your energy shield and drains mana per second to recover your life while you are not at full life.

entries.name: The Impaler
entries.definition: The Impaler is a keystone passive skill. Whenever a hit from you or your skills impales a target, that hit also impales all nearby enemies, and applies an additional 5 impale debuffs to each (for a total of 6). It then causes each affected enemy to avoid impale for 5 seconds, during which impales cannot be Called from them with Call of Steel.

entries.name: Totem
entries.definition: Totems are a type of creature. They can appear as both monsters and as allies, and are a type of proxy when summoned by skills.

entries.name: Transcendence
entries.definition: Transcendence is a keystone passive skill that causes armour to grant damage reduction against elemental damage instead of physical damage. It also lowers maximum elemental resistances.

entries.name: Trigger
entries.definition: Triggering is a skill behaviour that causes a skill's effect to occur when a condition is met, instantly, without requiring a character animation. It should not be confused with trap activation, which uses the same word for a different mechanic (in English language settings).

entries.name: Unarmed
entries.definition: Unarmed damage is a form of attack damage dealt by a character that does not have a weapon equipped. While it is unusual for most characters to ever use an unarmed attack, character builds based on unarmed damage can be made viable by using , , or Hollow Palm Technique. Though traditionally melee builds, ranged unarmed builds are possible with or .

entries.name: Unholy Might
entries.definition: Unholy Might is a buff that grants 100% of physical damage converted to chaos damage, and 25% chance to inflict Withered on hit.

entries.name: Unnerve
entries.definition: Unnerve is a debuff that causes affected targets to take 10% increased spell damage.

entries.name: Vaal Pact
entries.definition: Vaal Pact is a keystone passive skill that grants instant life leech to melee attacks, but prevents all other forms of life recovery.

entries.name: Vaal skill
entries.definition: Vaal skills are granted by Vaal skill gems, a special type of corrupt skill gem that grants an alternative version of the skill with powerful added effects fueled by the souls of slain enemies, as well as the regular version of the skill.

entries.name: Accuracy
entries.definition: Accuracy is a property of attack hits. Together with the target's evasion, it is used to calculate an attack's chance to hit. Spells do not benefit from accuracy, as they cannot be evaded.

entries.name: Warcry
entries.definition: Warcries are a type of skills that provide situational benefits to players while also taunting nearby enemies. Most warcries share the behaviour of buffing the user and nearby allies while also exerting a number of subsequent attacks, enhancing those attacks with additional properties.

entries.name: Ward
entries.definition: Ward is a defence capable of taking damage from hits before life or energy shield. It can only be found on item bases and uniques related to Expedition and Kingsmarch.

entries.name: Wicked Ward
entries.definition: Wicked Ward is a keystone passive skill that prevents energy shield recharge from being interrupted by damage if energy shield recharge began recently, but reduces your base energy shield recharge rate from 33% to 20%.

entries.name: Withered
entries.definition: Withered is a debuff which applies a 6% increased chaos damage taken on the affected target, stacking up to 15 times. Each stack has its own independent duration (base duration of 2s), which is not refreshed when applying new stacks.

entries.name: Zealot's Oath
entries.definition: Zealot's Oath is a keystone passive skill that applies life regeneration to energy shield instead of life.

entries.name: Bleeding
entries.definition: Bleeding, or bleed, is an ailment that deals physical damage over time to the affected target. Moving targets suffer increased bleeding damage. Only physical damage hits can inflict bleed. There are no sources of global chance to bleed or chance to bleed with spells. Thus, bleed is limited to attack skills only. Bleeding can be Aggravated to cause it to always deal damage as if the target is moving.

entries.name: Blocking
entries.definition: Blocking is a layer of defense that will entirely prevent damage from an enemy hit unless modified by some outside effect like . The chance to block is a random roll made for each hit. Characters and most enemies have 0% base block chance; enemies with a shield typically have some chance to block.

entries.name: Blood Magic
entries.definition: Blood Magic (often referred to as BM) is a keystone passive skill that changes all mana costs and reservations to life costs and reservations. It also grants more maximum life and removes your mana.

entries.name: Action speed
entries.definition: Action speed is a stat that determines how fast or slow a character performs actions, such as running, swinging a weapon, casting a spell, or recoiling from being stunned.

entries.name: Brand
entries.definition: Brands are duration spells that create skill effects that can attach to an enemy. While attached, brands periodically 'activate', causing additional effects, usually dealing damage.

entries.name: Skill gem
entries.definition: Skill gem (known as Active Skill Gems in item filter), is an item class which grants skills to the player by placing them into an item socket. Similar to support gems, skill gems can gain experience and level up increasing both their Attribute(s) and character level requirement as well as the effect of the stats granted by the skill.

entries.name: Brittle
entries.definition: Brittle is an Elemental Ailment associated with Cold. Hits against brittle enemies have up to +6% chance to critically strike afflicted enemies, based on the Cold Damage of the Hit that inflicted this ailment, for 4 seconds.

entries.name: Brutal charge
entries.definition: Brutal Charge is an alternative charge of . It's currently only granted from 's mod . Players can accumulate them the same way they generate endurance charges.

entries.name: Burning
entries.definition: Burning refers to any fire damage over time effect. Burning damage is a synonym for fire damage over time; all burning damage is fire damage over time, and vice versa.

entries.name: Adrenaline
entries.definition: Adrenaline is a buff that grants increased damage, movement, attack and cast speed, and additional physical damage reduction.

entries.name: Catalyst
entries.definition: Catalysts are currency items that add quality to jewellery. Catalyst quality on jewellery improves the effect of the implicit and explicit modifiers of the specified type, depending on the modifier tags. Modifier tags can be viewed by enabling Advanced Mod Descriptions in the UI options, and then holding the Alt key (default, it matches the item highlight keybind) while mousing over the item.

entries.name: Aegis
entries.definition: An aegis is a type of skill and associated buff granted by certain items and Ascendancy passive skills. While active, the buff takes a specified amount of damage from hits (typically of specific damage types) before it is dealt to life or energy shield until it is fully depleted. The aegis will automatically restore to full after a skill-specific duration after either fully depleting the buff or not taking hit damage of the aegis' type for the same duration. Aegis skills' mitigation takes priority before Guard Skills.

entries.name: Affliction charge
entries.definition: Affliction Charges are alternative charges of . They are currently only granted by 's mod . Players can accumulate them the same way they generate frenzy charges.

entries.name: Chainbreaker
entries.definition: Chainbreaker is a -only keystone passive skill. It grants rage regeneration based on mana regeneration, prevents mana recovery from regeneration, and adds a base cost of 3 rage to skills. Rage gained from this keystone does not delay inherent rage loss.

entries.name: Chaos Inoculation
entries.definition: Chaos Inoculation (often referred to as CI) is a keystone passive skill that grants immunity to chaos damage, but sets maximum life to 1.

entries.name: Chaos damage
entries.definition: Chaos damage is one of the five damage types. It is the rarest damage type and the hardest to get resistance against. Chaos damage bypasses energy shield, reducing life or mana directly. Although chaos damage reduction is based on resistance value, it is not considered elemental damage. One can become immune to chaos damage with the Chaos Inoculation keystone passive.

entries.name: Charge
entries.definition: Charges are counters that are represented as glowing orbs around an entity. They are not buffs.

entries.name: Chill
entries.definition: Chill is an elemental ailment inherent to cold that applies a slow effect to the character, reducing the animation speed at which the character plays. __TOC__

entries.name: Chilled ground
entries.definition: Chilled Ground is a detrimental ground effect that inflicts chill.

entries.name: Ailment
entries.definition: Ailments are a type of debuff associated and applied by one or more damage types. Ailments normally distinguish themselves from other debuffs by being applied by hits, which allows them to check conditions on the enemy, and vary their effect or duration based on damage instead of having a predetermined value from a skill or modifier.

entries.name: Cluster jewel
entries.definition: Cluster jewels are a type of jewels that can be socketed in the outermost sockets of the passive skill tree (known as Large Jewel Sockets). These jewels extend the skill tree by creating new clusters of nodes, which can contain small nodes which can have their stats modified by the jewel, notable passives, and even keystones. They can also create more jewel sockets (Medium or Small Jewel Sockets) which can support smaller cluster jewels. They are occasionally dropped from Delirium encounters or rewards.

entries.name: Cold damage
entries.definition: Cold damage is one of the five damage types and is one of the three types which count as elemental damage.

entries.name: Consecrated ground
entries.definition: Consecrated ground is a beneficial ground effect. The following effects are granted to those affected by it: * Regenerate 5% of maximum life per second * 50% reduced effect of curses on you

entries.name: Cooldown
entries.definition: A cooldown is a keyword property of skills. Skills with cooldowns cannot be used unless a cooldown is available. Once spent, a cooldown recovers over time.

entries.name: Corrupted
entries.definition: Corrupted is a special modifier. Corrupted items and strongboxes cannot be altered with most crafting methods, including restoration with an . There are limited ways to modify corrupted items.

entries.name: Corrupted Soul
entries.definition: Corrupted Soul is a keystone passive skill which causes 50% Non-Chaos Damage taken to bypass Energy Shield and grants 15% of Maximum Life as Extra Maximum Energy Shield.

entries.name: Curse
entries.definition: Curses are a category of debuff, most of which can be applied by player skills. Curses are split into two categories: Hexes and Marks.

entries.name: Damage conversion
entries.definition: Damage conversion is a mechanic that changes the damage type of a hit into another damage type. Damage conversions do not apply to damage over time.

entries.name: Damage effectiveness
entries.definition: Damage effectiveness is a property of skills that modifies the base and added flat damage of hits, primarily to prevent skills from benefiting disproportionately from flat damage. Low values of effectiveness are characteristic of skills that have high multipliers in other aspects of their damage application, such as a rapid hit rate or large damage modifiers.

entries.name: Damage over time
entries.definition: Damage over time (often referred to as DoT) is a damage inflicted continuously over a period of time. Unlike the other three damage sources, damage over time does not hit.

entries.name: Damage taken as
entries.definition: Damage taken as, also known as damage shift, is a mechanic that allows damage from one damage type to be taken as another damage type. Most of these modifiers specify they only apply to hits; a few rarer sources also apply to damage over time. Damage shift is not conversion.

entries.name: Dance with Death
entries.definition: Dance with Death is a keystone passive skill which makes both Critical strike chance and damage with Critical strikes Lucky, at the cost of disallowing the use of Helmets and causing enemies' critical strike damage to be Lucky against you. Luck only applies to hit damage, not ailment DPS.

entries.name: Desecrated ground
entries.definition: Desecrated Ground is a detrimental ground effect that deals chaos damage over time. The amount of damage per second inflicted by desecrated ground depends on its source. It is similar to caustic ground, which both deal Chaos DOT.

entries.name: Dexterity
entries.definition: The dexterity attribute is a measure of a character's agility and expertise. Dexterity is required to use dexterity-based equipment and skills.

entries.name: Divine Flesh
entries.definition: Divine Flesh is a keystone passive skill that causes you to take 50% of elemental damage as chaos damage and grants additional maximum chaos resistance, but causes all damage to bypass energy shield.

entries.name: Dodge
entries.definition: Dodge is a layer of defence that provides a chance to prevent hits.

entries.name: Double damage
entries.definition: Double damage is an effect that causes a hit to deal double its damage. Double damage does not stack with and is overridden by triple damage.

entries.name: Dual wielding
entries.definition: dual wielding two ]] Dual wielding refers to using a one-handed weapon in both hands.

entries.name: Duration
entries.definition: Duration is a keyword that refers to the attribute of certain effects that continue over time, and specify how long the effect remains.

entries.name: Eldritch Battery
entries.definition: Eldritch Battery (often referred to as EB) is a keystone passive skill that makes energy shield protect mana instead of life.

entries.name: Elemental Equilibrium
entries.definition: Elemental Equilibrium (often referred to as EE) is a keystone passive skill. Whenever you deal any elemental damage with a hit, it applies fire, cold, or lightning exposure of the element(s) that the hit didn't deal the element of, and removes the exposure type of the element(s) that did.

entries.name: Elemental Overload
entries.definition: Elemental Overload (often referred to as EO) is a keystone passive skill that causes skills to deal 40% more elemental damage with hits and ailments for 8 seconds after that skill deals a critical strike, but prevents any interactions between critical strikes and ailments. When the damage multiplier is active for a skill, it is indicated by a diamond on the bottom of that skill's icon in the skill bar.

entries.name: Elemental damage
entries.definition: Elemental Damage refers to fire damage, cold damage, and lightning damage collectively. Passives or items which refer to elemental damage or elemental resistance will affect all 3 of these Damage Types or Resistances.

entries.name: Elusive
entries.definition: Elusive is a buff which grants bonus movement speed and a chance to avoid damage from hits. It grants a large amount of avoid chance and movement speed when it is first applied, and the effectiveness of it decays over time. You must wait for Elusive to expire before you can re-apply it again at full strength.

entries.name: Endurance charge
entries.definition: Endurance charges are one of the three charge types. They are associated with strength, and grant additional physical and elemental damage reduction. They are visualized as glowing red orbs surrounding the character.

entries.name: Exposure
entries.definition: Exposures are debuffs that lower a specific elemental resistance.

entries.name: Fire damage
entries.definition: Fire damage is one of the five damage types and of the three types which count as elemental damage.

entries.name: Fortification
entries.definition: Fortification is a stackable buff. Entities inherently have 1% less damage taken from hits per stack of Fortification. By default, it has a maximum of 20 stacks and lasts 6 seconds. The amount of stacks gained per hit depends on a combination of the hit's damage, the enemy's ailment threshold, and the enemy's rarity.

entries.name: Fractured item
entries.definition: Fractured items are of a special type of item base that have at least one affix coloured in gold () that is permanently fixed on the item. Items with fractured mod(s) can be dropped from rare monsters, rewards from various content, or created via using a Fracturing Orb.

entries.name: Freeze
entries.definition: Freeze (known in status as Frozen) is an elemental ailment associated with cold that causes affected targets to become frozen solid, preventing them from moving or using skills directly. Certain enemies cannot be fully slowed, but can still be considered frozen, which will result in them having significantly lower action speed.

entries.name: Frenzy charge
entries.definition: Frenzy charges are one of the three basic charge types. They are associated with dexterity and represent a temporary increase to swiftness and fervor during combat. The charges are visualized as glowing green orbs surrounding the character.

entries.name: Full life
entries.definition: Full Life is a condition that applies when the character's current life is at 100%. Full Life works when under the influence of Chaos Inoculation.

entries.name: Ghost Dance
entries.definition: Ghost Dance is a keystone on the passive tree. It generates a Ghost Shroud every two seconds, up to a maximum of three Ghost Shrouds. When hit, a Ghost Shroud is removed and recovers energy shield equal to a percentage of your evasion rating.

entries.name: Ghost Reaver
entries.definition: Ghost Reaver is a keystone passive skill that causes the player to leech energy shield instead of life, and doubles the maximum total recovery per second from energy shield leech, with the downside of disabling energy shield recharge.

entries.name: Glancing Blows
entries.definition: Glancing Blows is a keystone passive skill which grants doubles both Attack and Spell Block chance while causing you to take 65% of the blocked hit's damage.

entries.name: Golem
entries.definition: Golems are a type of minion. Non-transfigured versions of golems provide a buff to its owner while alive (exception: Summon Carrion Golem); multiple copies of the same golem will not stack the buffs. A player can have a maximum of one active Golem by default.

entries.name: Ground effect
entries.definition: A ground effect is the general term for a patch of terrain that has some consequence on characters or monsters positioned on it. Burning ground created by the skill is one common example of a ground effect.

entries.name: Guard
entries.definition: Guard is a type of Blackguard which accompanies Guard Captain.

entries.name: Spell suppression
entries.definition: Spell Suppression is a type of mitigation associated with dexterity. By default, it provides a chance to lower the damage of hits and ailments inflicted by spells by 40%.

entries.name: Lethe Shade
entries.definition: Lethe Shade is a keystone passive skill which enables you to take 50% less Damage over Time if you've started taking Damage over Time in the past second, at the cost of having 100% more Duration of Ailments on you.

entries.name: Herald
entries.definition: Herald is a gem tag associated with active skills which grant the user both a damage buff and a special effect upon hitting or killing an enemy under certain conditions. Each Herald has a base mana reservation of 25%.

entries.name: Hinder
entries.definition: Hinder is a debuff that reduces movement speed on the affected target. A creature can only be affected by one Hinder at a time; if a creature is hindered by multiple sources, only the strongest Hinder takes effect.

entries.name: Hit
entries.definition: The term hit refers to any damage that isn't damage over time.

entries.name: Hollow Palm Technique
entries.definition: Hollow Palm Technique is a keystone passive skill which grants various bonuses while the player is Unencumbered (being Unarmed with no off-hand or gloves equipped).

entries.name: Mastery
entries.definition: Masteries are special passive skills present on most passive skill clusters of the skill tree, which can be allocated after allocating a notable in their cluster. They are found in all passive clusters outside of the class starting areas. Once allocated, the player can choose a bonus from a list of thematically appropriate passive bonuses from the mastery to obtain. Allocating a mastery passive requires one skill point. The set of mastery passives offered are shared among their respective cluster categories, so for example a player can allocate a Fire Mastery from any of several Fire-related clusters, but the same mastery cannot be allocated twice.

entries.name: Ignite
entries.definition: Ignite is a damaging elemental ailment associated with fire that causes the affected target to take burning damage (fire damage over time).

entries.name: Immortal Ambition
entries.definition: Immortal Ambition is a keystone passive skill which allows life leech to recover energy shield while on full life, while disabling energy shield recharge and energy shield regeneration, and causing 5% energy shield loss per second.

entries.name: Immunity
entries.definition: Immunity is a stat that prevents and removes certain effects (e.g. debuffs or ailments) or nullifies certain damage types. Immunity is typically worded as either or .

entries.name: Influenced item
entries.definition: Influenced items are special types of base items with an expanded pool of exclusive modifiers, and are the only type of items that can obtain elevated modifiers. They can be recognized by their graphical effects and icon on the sides of the name plate. Influenced items are primarily dropped by influenced monsters and bosses. Certain unique items are influenced as well.

entries.name: Intelligence
entries.definition: The intelligence attribute is a measure of a character's knowledge and mental acuity. Intelligence is required to use intelligence-based equipment and skills.

entries.name: Intimidate
entries.definition: Intimidated is a debuff that causes the affected target to take 10% increased attack damage.

entries.name: Iron Reflexes
entries.definition: Iron Reflexes is a keystone passive skill that converts all evasion rating into armour. It also removes the bonus to evasion rating that dexterity inherently grants.

entries.name: Triple damage
entries.definition: Triple damage is an effect that causes a hit to deal triple its damage. Triple damage overrides and does not stack with double damage.

entries.name: Item socket
entries.definition: Item sockets are slots on equipment or resonators into which other items can be placed.

entries.name: Keystone
entries.definition: A Keystone is a unique and powerful passive skill node that significantly impacts the way a character is played.

entries.name: Leech
entries.definition: Leech recovers an amount of life, mana, or energy shield over time, relative to the damage inflicted on an enemy. Leech is based on the damage taken by the enemy, not the amount of life removed.

entries.name: Sentinel
entries.definition: Sentinels are a league mechanic introduced in the Sentinel league. Sentinels can be activated to have them fire beams that empower a limited number of monsters and improve their item drops.

entries.name: Absorption charge
entries.definition: Absorption Charge is an alternative charge to . It is only granted from the 's mod . Players can generate them the same way they generate power charges.

entries.name: Lightning damage
entries.definition: Lightning damage is one of the five damage types and is one of the three types that count as elemental damage.

entries.name: Area of effect
entries.definition: Area of effect (often referred to as AoE) refers to mechanics (such as skills, auras, and monster abilities) that apply to an area of the ground (rather than targeting a particular character, monster, etc.).

entries.name: Unmodifiable
entries.definition: Unmodifiable is a property of certain items. An item that is unmodifiable cannot have any of its properties, base stats or modifiers altered by any means. The only exception is that an unmodifiable item can be identified. However, valid item bases can be used on the Recombinator to create a new item.

entries.name: Fire damage
entries.definition: Fire damage is one of the five damage types and of the three types which count as elemental damage.

entries.name: Cold damage
entries.definition: Cold damage is one of the five damage types and is one of the three types which count as elemental damage.

entries.name: Lightning damage
entries.definition: Lightning damage is one of the five damage types and is one of the three types that count as elemental damage.

entries.name: Physical Damage
entries.definition: One of the five damage types. Armour mitigates physical damage from hits; it does not mitigate physical damage over time such as bleeding.

entries.name: Chaos damage
entries.definition: Chaos damage is one of the five damage types. It is the rarest damage type and the hardest to get resistance against. Chaos damage bypasses energy shield, reducing life or mana directly. Although chaos damage reduction is based on resistance value, it is not considered elemental damage. One can become immune to chaos damage with the Chaos Inoculation keystone passive.
